races.race_name: Highclere Thoroughbred Racing Geoffrey Freer Stakes (Group 3)

runners.name: Dubai Honour
runners.spotlight: 8yo with high-class performances around the globe over 1m2f-1m4f but he's never been beyond that; below form in Australia in April when last seen but his performance there the time before was up with his best form; usually runs well after a break; there's a question whether ground firmer than good is ideal but he is very much the class act in this field.
runners.comment: High-class performances around the globe over 1m2f-1m4f but he's never been beyond that
runners.owner: Exors of the late Mohamed Obaida

runners.name: Tabletalk
runners.spotlight: Won the Melrose Handicap at York in August 2024; 0-10 since but runner-up in six of those races, including at York (1m6f) on last two starts in close finishes also involving Mount Atlas (who now carries a 3lb penalty); the lack of a recent win has become frustrating, particularly as he had the initiative for most of the closing stages last time, losing it in the last three strides; cheekpieces (tried once last term, runner-up) return; second to Dubai Honour in terms of form.
runners.comment: On a losing run; close with Mount Atlas on last two starts and now has a 3lb pull

runners.name: Gamrai
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who has come into his own in a major way; second on good to firm at Newmarket (1m4f) and Royal Ascot (1m6f) in his last two starts; has since changed hands and left the Gosdens; climbing the ladder and although another major step up is required against Dubai Honour on this move out of handicaps, he should be highly competitive against the rest.
runners.comment: New connections, having left the Gosdens; climbing the ladder in handicaps

runners.name: Wine Dark Sea
runners.spotlight: 3-6 in handicaps, including winning warm events on good to firm at Ascot (1m4f) and Carlisle (1m3f) on first two starts this year; absolutely hacked up in the latter but subsided disappointingly in the closing stages for valuable 1m6f handicap at Newmarket (made most) 16 days later; dam is sister to a 1m5f-2m winner, suggesting he should stay beyond 1m4f; even if back on song, however, this rise in class suggests he will register a place at best.
runners.comment: Flopped latest in his bid to complete handicap hat-trick; this is a steep rise in class
runners.owner: Sonny Grebe, Aus Bloodstock, D Gilbert

runners.name: Rebel Rocker
runners.spotlight: Grabbed a maiden at Kempton (1m, AW) in November and came from last to second in a six-runner Listed race at Epsom (1m2f, good; 33-1) in April; 66-1 but rallied well for sixth of 14 in the Derby at Epsom (1m4f, soft) ten weeks ago, admittedly about 10l behind the winner, so he has a lot to find on ratings, but this St Leger entry probably has untapped potential at 1m4f+.
runners.comment: 66-1, rallied well for sixth of 14 in the Derby (1m4f, soft) latest, albeit beaten 10l

races.race_name: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap

runners.name: Kinswoman
runners.spotlight: Gained three 5f wins in the second half of 2025, but disappointing this year after a promising reappearance; needs to get back on track but drops back in grade after facing a stiff task in York Grade 3 last time.
runners.comment: Disappointing after promising reappearance; back down in grade after stiff task on latest

runners.name: Glamorous Breeze
runners.spotlight: Likeable 8yo mare with a consistent record and ten wins to her name; as good as ever when third of 23 at Glorious Goodwood (5f, good) last month, keeping on gamely; should go well again off 1lb higher.
runners.comment: Consistent 8yo; fine third of 23 at Glorious Goodwood; should go well again off 1lb higher

runners.name: Regal Envoy
runners.spotlight: Has added to his impressive tally with two further 5f wins this season but recent defeats suggest he's gone off the boil somewhat; dropped 2lb since last run but may need some more assistance from the handicapper.
runners.comment: Two further 5f wins this season but recent defeats suggest he's gone off the boil somewhat

runners.name: Kanishka
runners.spotlight: Sole win over 7f as 2yo for Brian Ellison; never dangerous over 6f on yard debut at Goodwood 17 days ago and now drops back even further in trip.
runners.comment: 7f winner; never dangerous over 6f on stable debut and now drops back even further in trip

runners.name: Rhythm N Hooves
runners.spotlight: Won this 12 months ago off 9lb higher; 0-15 since and a change of headgear (retained) failed to stop the slide at Ascot three weeks ago.
runners.comment: Won this race 12 months ago off a 9lb higher mark but 0-15 since

runners.name: Hypnotised
runners.spotlight: Speedy type who will probably prove best at 5f; having first run after gelding operation and three months off when second to Wheels Of Fire at Sandown; may well improve for that outing and he still has untapped potential.
runners.comment: Speedy type; encouraging return from gelding op at Sandown; still has untapped potential

runners.name: The Thames Boatman
runners.spotlight: Won at Goodwood (5f, good) in the spring and has remained in form, second of seven at Lingfield last time; no obvious reason why he won't be thereabouts again but he's fully exposed after 52 starts.
runners.comment: Won at Goodwood in the spring and has remained in form, but he's fully exposed

runners.name: Ziggy's Triton
runners.spotlight: In and out this season but has gained 5f wins at Musselburgh (good) and York (good to firm); not entirely disgraced in big field at Goodwood last time and could make his presence felt.
runners.comment: 5f wins at Musselburgh and York this term; could make his presence felt

runners.name: River Spey
runners.spotlight: Best effort when getting off the mark on turf at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in June; lost his chance at the start next time and then seemed to find things happening too quickly over Goodwood's sharp 5f; today's stiffer track should be in his favour, and we may not have seen the best of him yet.
runners.comment: Excuses since Windsor win in June; may not have reached his ceiling just yet

runners.name: Wheels Of Fire
runners.spotlight: Both 2026 wins were 5f and he was decisively on top at Sandown (good ground) 17 days ago; that was a personal best and he's in the mix, although significantly worse off at the weights with Sandown runner-up Hypnotised.
runners.comment: Decisive winner at Sandown 17 days ago; in the mix again but much higher in weights here

runners.name: Hucklesbrook
runners.spotlight: Dual 6f winner in 2025; regressive in 2026, tenth of 13 at Windsor last time on first run after wind surgery; very best form is over further but he has fallen below his last winning mark and Seamus Cronin's claim is a plus.
runners.comment: Dual 6f winner in 2025; regressive this year but mark has fallen and a revival is possible

runners.name: Major Neigh Sayer
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f novice as a 2yo and he ran over 1m on his reappearance, but his two runs since have been over this distance; went off favourite but met trouble on both occasions, and he has since been gelded; hard to pin down but he's relatively lightly raced and probably has more to offer.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 3yo; sent off favourite last two starts but has met trouble; more to offer

races.race_name: TPT Fire Handicap

runners.name: Christian David
runners.spotlight: 0-8 this season but he's been bubbling under, and he'd have gone close to winning at Haydock (7f, good) last Saturday but for being badly hampered inside the final 1f; dangerous if he's fully recovered from that.
runners.comment: Badly hampered when challenging at Haydock last week; dangerous if recovered from that

runners.name: Scoville
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all five starts since winning his first two races, but there have been excuses; shaped well after making much of the running in the Royal Hunt Cup, and then used up too much energy from a wide draw in the Golden Mile at Goodwood; dropping back from 1m to 7f is an interesting move and he still has untapped potential.
runners.comment: Unplaced since winning first two races but there have been excuses; has untapped potential
runners.owner: Sir M Arbib,B Arbib,C Budgett & A Kheir

runners.name: Stellar Sunrise
runners.spotlight: Reappeared with a convincing C&D win (good ground) but hasn't built on that at all; gelded before finishing down the field at Ascot three weeks ago and now cheekpieces are fitted; needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Reappeared with convincing C&D win but hasn't built on that at all; cheekpieces on

runners.name: Addison Grey
runners.spotlight: Has some solid 6f form this year, including when chasing home subsequent Wokingham winner Double Rush at Newmarket; far from disgraced from unfavourable draw at York three weeks ago; big player if seeing out today's extra yardage.
runners.comment: Has some solid 6f form; unfavorably drawn last time; big player if staying the longer trip

runners.name: Humam
runners.spotlight: Seemed in the doldrums prior to third of ten at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last Saturday; had slipped in the weights and he's well treated on the pick of his 3yo form; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Resurgent third at Newmarket last Saturday; well treated on the pick of his 3yo form

runners.name: Great Acclaim
runners.spotlight: 7f specialist, not beaten far in Ascot's Victoria Cup (good) and Buckingham Palace Stakes (good to firm) in first half of this year; never able to challenge over same C&D last time; this is less competitive and he should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: 7f specialist, not beaten far in Victoria Cup and Buckingham Palace Stakes; in the mix

runners.name: Havana Pusey
runners.spotlight: Often blows the start; everything clicked when she won at Yarmouth (7f, good) in April but she's been more miss than hit otherwise this year; others have less to prove.
runners.comment: More miss than hit this year and others have less to prove

runners.name: Witch Hunter
runners.spotlight: Hard to predict; followed six duck eggs with a last-gasp win at Thirsk (1m, good) two weeks ago, only to run poorly again at Haydock last week; just 2lb higher than for the win but can't be relied on.
runners.comment: Thirsk win came out of the blue; mostly well beaten otherwise on turf this year

races.race_name: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)

runners.name: Extremely Zain
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 3yo; made it 3-3 when winning a big-field handicap at York (7f, good) in June with plenty in hand; lost his unbeaten record in the International Handicap at Ascot next time but met some trouble and still posted another personal best; seriously unexposed and can take this step up in grade in his stride.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 3yo; progressive in handicaps; can take this step up in grade in his stride

runners.name: Never So Brave
runners.spotlight: 7f wins include the Group 1 City Of York Stakes last summer; not quite at his best this year, although a sixth in the Sussex Stakes at Goodwood last month (80-1) was no disgrace; back down in grade and returns to his optimum distance so should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: 7f Group 1 winner last summer; back down in grade and returns to optimum distance here

runners.name: Coppull
runners.spotlight: Has raced only at sprint distances; ran well in the face of a stiff task when fourth of 11 in the Group 1 July Cup at Newmarket (6f, good to firm; 28-1) last month; that makes him one of the leading contenders on form but he does need to prove his stamina for today's longer trip.
runners.comment: Last month's fourth in 6f July Cup makes him a leading form contender; stamina to prove

runners.name: Symbol Of Honour
runners.spotlight: Resurgent when winning 6f Group 3 here (good to firm) last month, leading 2f out and keeping on well; all his successes have come at that distance but under these quick conditions he should be fine back at 7f; unbeaten at Newbury and has to be considered now that he's back in top form.
runners.comment: Resurgent when winning 6f Group 3 here last month; 2-2 at Newbury and has to be considered

runners.name: Witness Stand
runners.spotlight: Ran as well as he's ever done when second in this race 12 months ago, and he was a creditable third in Group 2 at Glorious Goodwood (7f, good) last time; solid credentials and unlikely to be far away.
runners.comment: Second 12 months ago; creditable third at Glorious Goodwood last time; solid credentials

runners.name: Northern Champion
runners.spotlight: Back on the up with hard-fought 7f Listed win at Chester (good) in July, before finishing down the field in Stewards' Cup at Goodwood; returning to this trip should suit but he has a fair bit to find on the figures.
runners.comment: Back on the up with hard-fought Listed win at Chester; fair bit to find on the figures

runners.name: Back In Black
runners.spotlight: Useful handicapper, runner-up in the Bunbury Cup at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) in July; however, well beaten at Ascot since and now faces a much higher calibre of opposition.
runners.comment: Useful handicapper, runner-up in Bunbury Cup; faces much higher calibre of opposition here

runners.name: Sukanya
runners.spotlight: Came from behind to win the Group 3 Fred Darling over C&D (good) on reappearance; tougher assignments over 1m since, racing freely in Ascot Group 3 on latest; this return to 7f is a plus but others have more obvious claims.
runners.comment: Unplaced three times since C&D Fred Darling win; others have more obvious claims

runners.name: Prince Of India
runners.spotlight: Usually races at 6f nowadays but probably just as effective at 7f; seemed to excel himself in first-time blinkers when sixth of 11 in Group 1 July Cup at Newmarket (good to firm; 80-1) five weeks ago; not ruled out if repeating that form.
runners.comment: Seemed to excel himself in blinkers when sixth in Group 1 July Cup; not ruled out

races.race_name: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Red Tail
runners.spotlight: Close second of five at Brighton (6f, good to firm; 3-1) last Friday, sticking on well after running green; should improve and be at least as effective over this longer trip, but there looks to be more strength in depth to this race.
runners.comment: Close second of five at Brighton; probably more strength in depth to this race

runners.name: Silent Force
runners.spotlight: No Nay Never half-brother to winners Arabian Force (Group-placed 1m/1m2f; RPR 112), Sea The Casper (Listed-placed 1m-1m3f; 112) and Golden Story (1m 2yo/1m3f Listed; 103); dam unraced sister to 1m Group 1 winner Rizeena; bred to be smart, and top stable won this race 12 months ago.
runners.comment: No Nay Never colt; bred to be smart, and top stable won this race 12 months ago

runners.name: San Jose
runners.spotlight: 105,000euros yearling; Blackbeard half-brother to winners Juan De Montalban (Group-placed 1m1f-1m4f including 2yo; RPR 109), Pintara (1m 2yo including Listed; 104) and Oxford Comma (1m2f-2m2f; 100); dam Listed-placed 1m3f AW winner (98); has a useful pedigree and holds entries in the Royal Lodge and Dewhurst this autumn; interesting debutant.
runners.comment: Has a useful pedigree and holds entries in Royal Lodge and Dewhurst; interesting debutant

runners.name: Gallego
runners.spotlight: 55,000gns yearling; Havana Gold half-brother to winners Camelot Tales (1m2f; RPR 93) and Tempted (8.6f AW; 72); dam 7f/1m winner (108), half-sister to 1m2f-14.5f winner Rocktherunway; stable's 2yos yet to start firing (0-3) this season.
runners.comment: 55,000gns yearling; by Havana Gold; stable's 2yos yet to get going (0-3) this season

runners.name: Mr Montgomery
runners.spotlight: Coulsty half-brother to winners Capuchinero (6f-1m; RPR 84), Arendelle (1m; 72), Gallagher (Australian 10.5f) and Doune Castle (3m/3m2f hurdle); dam unraced half-sister to 1m2f Listed winner Mashaahed; others preferred.
runners.comment: Coulsty newcomer, a half-brother to four winners; others preferred

runners.name: Mister Whippy
runners.spotlight: Green throughout but passed a few late on when fourth of nine at Doncaster (7f, good to firm; 33-1) three weeks ago; cost 150,000euros as a yearling and has plenty of potential; could make a big step forward.
runners.comment: Very green on debut but passed a few to finish fourth; could make a big step forward

runners.name: Mosheer
runners.spotlight: 185,000gns yearling; by New Bay; dam Listed-placed 1m winner (RPR 92), half-sister to winners My Lord And Master (Listed-placed 1m 2yo) and Zain Blue (1m), out of unraced half-sister to 1m2f Group 3 winner Grand Duca; local stable operates at over 20% with its 2yos and this one appeals on pedigree.
runners.comment: 185,000gns yearling; local yard operates at 20% with 2yos and this one appeals on pedigree

runners.name: Saint Mungo
runners.spotlight: 85,000gns yearling; by Gleneagles; dam third at 1m (RPR 74), closely related to 6f 2yo winner Song Of Shadows, out of 1m winning half-sister to 1m2f Grade 1 winner Debussy; yard does well with 2yos; one of the likelier types.
runners.comment: 85,000gns yearling; by Gleneagles; yard does well with 2yos; one of the likelier types

runners.name: Diamondise
runners.spotlight: 10,000euros yearling; by Space Traveller; dam 5.7f 2yo winner (RPR 81), half-sister to 1m-1m4f winner Sheila's Treat; other newcomers are more obvious types.
runners.comment: 10,000euros yearling; by Space Traveller; other newcomers are more obvious types

runners.name: Lots Road
runners.spotlight: 100,000gns yearling; Too Darn Hot half-brother to 1m2f/1m4f winner Lord Melbourne (RPR 107); dam French 1m2f/1m4f winner (92) from family of 1m2f Group 2 winner Loup Breton; bred to be useful and represents a leading stable; makes plenty of appeal on paper.
runners.comment: Bred to be useful and represents a leading stable; makes plenty of appeal on paper

runners.name: Maktoo
runners.spotlight: £32,000 yearling; Too Darn Hot half-brother to 5f winner Love Love (RPR 76); dam Listed-placed 6f winner (100), half-sister to French 1m Listed winner Polygreen (dam of 6.5f Group 1 winner Polydream); worth monitoring in the market.
runners.comment: £32,000 yearling; Too Darn Hot half-brother to 5f winner Love Love; worth  a market check

runners.name: Gambling Man
runners.spotlight: Early foal by Cotai Glory; shaped nicely when fourth of 18 over 6f here (good to firm; 28-1) last month, doing best work late on after losing his footing at halfway; should build on that run and stay this extra furlong.
runners.comment: Shaped nicely when fourth here on debut; should build on that and stay this extra furlong

runners.name: Another Encore
runners.spotlight: Showed some improvement on debut form when fifth of eight at Ascot (7f, good to firm) last month, although still beaten 8l at 100-1; type to keep progressing but probably needs a big leap forward here.
runners.comment: Better form on second run than on debut but probably needs another big leap forward
runners.owner: Dean De Zoete Inglett Morris Palmer Rees

races.race_name: Swings & Smiles Supported By AP&C Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Great Bedwyn
runners.spotlight: Beaten on his last 15 starts but placed over 1m4f/1m2f in three of his five races this term; has the form for another prominent finish and is claimer ridden for the first time.
runners.comment: Beaten on his last 15 starts but placed at 1m4f/1m2f in three of his five races this term

runners.name: Masterinthewoods
runners.spotlight: Won at Salisbury in May and improved again when second since at Goodwood (again 1m4f on good) and Ascot (1m4f, good to firm); versatile tactically and made the running last time; raised another 3lb but looks set for another bold show.
runners.comment: Progressing over 1m4f; raised another 3lb but looks set for another bold show

runners.name: Explode
runners.spotlight: Has rather a mixed record (had wind surgery in January) but latest start was a ready win in four-runner race at Catterick (1m4f, good to firm) last month; back up 4lb but has to be considered.
runners.comment: Rather a mixed record but latest start was a ready win in four-runner race at Catterick

runners.name: Pinatique
runners.spotlight: From a smart French middle-distance/staying family; started career with two wins there early last year and although she's 0-6 since for Jean-Claude Rouget, that's mostly been in Listed races and her penultimate piece of form (1m4f) gives her possibilities on this handicap, stable and seasonal debut; the betting market should give further clues.
runners.comment: Pick of her French form gives possibilities on this handicap, stable and seasonal debut

runners.name: Tryfan
runners.spotlight: Peak efforts on AW but he won on good to firm last May and did so again when he first tried cheekpieces in eight-runner race at Ascot (1m4f; by a neck, led over 2f out) five weeks ago; back up 3lb but in the mix in small field.
runners.comment: First cheekpieces when he won at Ascot (1m4f; by a neck, led over 2f out) five weeks ago

races.race_name: Get Following BetVictor On Instagram Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Bayaann
runners.spotlight: Didn't reproduce reappearance form when having to work hard for his win at 1-4 in a novice at Windsor (1m, good to soft) in June; never dangerous on handicap debut 12 days later, which isn't hard to forgive seeing as that was Royal Ascot (18-1) and the move up to 1m2f that day should have suited him well; gelded since; dropped 3lb and could still bring potential.
runners.comment: Never dangerous on Royal Ascot handicap debut (18-1) when 1m2f should have suited; gelded

runners.name: Wild Thoughts
runners.spotlight: Won his first four handicaps (1m/7f) and close next time; cheekpieces for both starts since (1m, good to firm) when disappointing at Newmarket and hanging right late on in a respectable ninth at Goodwood; needs to resume progress but stamina in the family makes this new trip look interesting.
runners.comment: Needs to resume progress but stamina in the family makes this new trip look interesting

runners.name: Dream Camp
runners.spotlight: 80-1 when soundly beaten on handicap debut in fillies race at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) in June; won starts either side, though, and travelling best suggests she was better than the bare result when she took seven-runner handicap at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) last time; up 4lb but more to give.
runners.comment: Travelled best when she won seven-runner handicap at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm); up 4lb

runners.name: Golden Knight
runners.spotlight: There was market interest in him when the widest draw did not play out to his advantage on handicap debut at Royal Ascot (1m4f, good to firm); rallied gamely when narrow winner of a four-runner race at Ascot (1m2f, good to firm) five weeks ago, for which he dictated the pace and has gone up 3lb since but he should not yet be exposed at 1m2f.
runners.comment: Rallied gamely for narrow win in a four-runner race at Ascot (1m2f, good to firm); up 3lb

runners.name: Runman
runners.spotlight: Started his career with two 1m novice wins on good ground and ran well in defeat next time; 50-1, however, when tongue tied for first time on handicap debut at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) eight weeks ago and faded to be well beaten; this race is far less daunting and his dam was a 1m1f/1m2f winner, so it will again be interesting to gauge his market strength.
runners.comment: 50-1 when well beaten on handicap debut at Royal Ascot (1m); dam was a 1m1f/1m2f winner

races.race_name: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Coral Cove
runners.spotlight: Confirmed the promise of her Doncaster debut second when pulling well clear at York (7f, good to firm) 22 days ago, with a few of today's rivals behind; 1m will suit and ought to take a bit of stopping if she can get across and obtain a good position from her wide draw.
runners.comment: Second on debut before winning easily at York (both 7f); 1m will suit and tough to beat

runners.name: Tommo's Queen
runners.spotlight: Cracksman filly who was green but displayed promise once she got the hang of things when fourth of 13 on 7f Redcar debut (good to firm) four weeks ago; 1m will suit and she's open to improvement.
runners.comment: Promise amidst greenness when keeping-on fourth on 7f Redcar debut; more to come at 1m

runners.name: Bedwyr
runners.spotlight: Completely blew the start when trailing home last on debut; got away on terms and showed ability when fifth of 13 at Redcar (7f, good to firm) since, with the reopposing Tommo's Queen narrowly ahead in fourth.
runners.comment: Closely matched with Tommo's Queen on last month's Redcar form; place claims

runners.name: Temple Court
runners.spotlight: Has reached the frame on all three outings since his debut but his form is little better than modest and latest Chesptow fourth was over 6f so this is a different test; the good form of his stable's juveniles provides hope, though.
runners.comment: Modest form when reaching frame three times over shorter trips

runners.name: The First Drop
runners.spotlight: Made an encouraging start when second of 11 over 7f at Carlisle (good to firm) in June; sent off second favourite to Coral Cove at York a month later but weakened quickly (hung right) to finish last of eight; subsequently gelded; needs to recapture the debut form.
runners.comment: Promising second on debut but last of eight to Coral Cove at York since; gelded after

runners.name: Nosey Book
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two 7f starts, beaten just under 7l when third at Musselburgh in cheekpieces (retained) latterly; improvement needed now stepping up to 1m.
runners.comment: Modest form in two 7f starts and needs improvement now going up to 1m

runners.name: Mad Jack
runners.spotlight: £32,000 yearling; closely related to 1m-1m2f winner Zarabanda (RPR 102); dam Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner (91); her stable isn't really noted for 2yo winners but reasonable pedigree warrants a betting check.
runners.comment: Yard isn't really noted for 2yo winners but reasonable pedigree warrants a betting check

runners.name: Dee's Mochafella
runners.spotlight: £30,000 half-brother to winners Under The Twilight (6f/7f including AW; RPR 95) and Miss Nightcap (6f turf/7f AW; 92); dam 6f winner (86); the stable has yet to have a 2yo winner but bred to have a future and Danny Tudhope is 2-9 for the stable; has the outside stall but still worth a second look in the betting.
runners.comment: Drawn wide but decent pedigree and Danny Tudhope rides so worth a look in betting

runners.name: Old Oak
runners.spotlight: Green and never involved on 6f Newbury debut 37 days ago; has stamina in his pedigree, though, so the 2f step up in trip could see him in a better light.
runners.comment: Never involved on 6f debut but this 2f longer trip is bred to suit

runners.name: Rule Of The Agency
runners.spotlight: Left debut behind when third over 7f at York (good to firm) 22 days ago but the reopposing Coral Cove was 7l ahead of him; 1m is bred to suit but even a 6lb swing in the weights with James Owen's filly doesn't look enough.
runners.comment: 7l third to Coral Cove at York; 6lb better off with her now but that doesn't look enough

runners.name: Special Operations
runners.spotlight: 33-1, finished a neck behind reopposing stablemate Rule Of The Agency when fourth to Coral Cove on last month's York debut (7f, good to firm); should improve for the experience.
runners.comment: Closely matched with Rule Of The Agency on York debut form but Coral Cove well ahead

runners.name: Scarlet Dynasty
runners.spotlight: More one for low-grade nurseries based on his efforts over 6f/7f last month.
runners.comment: More one for low-grade nurseries based on his efforts over 6f/7f last month

runners.name: London Rose
runners.spotlight: 40-1 when well held on 7f Newcastle debut seven weeks ago; can only watch after that.
runners.comment: 40-1 when well held on 7f Newcastle debut seven weeks ago

races.race_name: Racing For Tamara Ripon Hornblower EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Rogue Jewel
runners.spotlight: Mehmas filly who got up on the line to make a winning debut at York (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; likely to progress and the one to beat for in-form Ed Bethell.
runners.comment: Promising winning debut at York three weeks ago and can make it 2-2

runners.name: Green Bay Dream
runners.spotlight: From a good family and displayed promise when 4.5l second to a well-touted newcomer from the Crisford stable over C&D (good to firm) 19 days ago; the third has boosted that form by winning since; can be expected to improve.
runners.comment: Form of C&D debut second boosted by the third; will improve

runners.name: Does Mary Know
runners.spotlight: Promise when sixth of 15 in a warm 6f maiden on Glorious Goodwood debut (good to firm) 18 days ago; likely improver for an in-form stable which won this in 2023.
runners.comment: Promising sixth in warm race on debut and likely to progress for in-form stable

runners.name: Classy Jaguar
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in two 5f Beverley outings, latterly on Wednesday; outsider.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in two Beverley outings, latterly on Wednesday

runners.name: Taj Mahal Palace
runners.spotlight: Minor late headway when seventh of ten on 5f Beverley debut (good to firm) on Wednesday; needs to leave that well behind turned out again quickly.
runners.comment: Only seventh on Beverley debut on Wednesday

races.race_name: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap

runners.name: Who Wants Me
runners.spotlight: Underwent a second wind operation prior to her return to action in May and it appears to have done the trick, as she followed her breakthrough win at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) with a comfortable success at Ayr (5f, good); poorly drawn at York last time (wore cheekpieces); could still have a bigger run in her.
runners.comment: Not well drawn when disappointing at York latest; could still have more to offer

runners.name: Glory Hyde
runners.spotlight: Won four times in the first half of 2026 but she has come up short in Class 4 events on her last two starts; 2-3 over C&D but perhaps a shade high in the weights for now.
runners.comment: Four wins this year, two over C&D, but perhaps a shade high in the weights now

runners.name: Beyond Borders
runners.spotlight: The addition of a tongue-tie saw him return to winning ways at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in June; the tongue-tie was left off on last month's stable debut and he ran creditably in fifth at Southwell; this may prove too competitive.
runners.comment: Tongue-tied when winning on AW in June; goes without it today on 2nd run for Gemma Tutty

runners.name: Mythical Composer
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a 7f win at Kempton (cheekpieces first time); well beaten at Goodwood 17 days ago on his return from a 175-day break (gelded during the absence); better than that but still not easily recommended.
runners.comment: Well beaten after break at Goodwood 17 days ago; better than that but needs a full revival

runners.name: Magic Boy
runners.spotlight: Produced a strong finish to win a 6f handicap at York last month; strong in the betting back at York three weeks ago but could manage only seventh after his rider removed his blindfold late; still has handicapping scope.
runners.comment: Had an excuse last time and likely he's still ahead of his mark; one to consider

runners.name: Woodstock
runners.spotlight: Better known for his exploits over further but he ran well for second in a C&D handicap last August; several good runs in defeat this year but this looks a competitive race in which to end a two-year drought.
runners.comment: All wins over 7f+ but does have C&D form; two years since last success though

runners.name: Emperor Caradoc
runners.spotlight: Scored off this mark at Thirsk in May; has generally run to form since but he hasn't been at his best in two visits to Ripon; new headgear tried this afternoon.
runners.comment: Thirsk win off this mark in May and run several good races in defeat since; new headgear

runners.name: Educating Rita
runners.spotlight: Low-key stable debut at York last month but she fared much better when third of 21 back there 13 days later; runs off the same mark today and she's not out of it.
runners.comment: 50-1 when third of 21 at York last month; same mark today; not ruled out

runners.name: Mark's Choice
runners.spotlight: Ten-time course winner; he has done enough this year to think he could add to that tally but this may prove too competitive for the veteran.
runners.comment: Ten-time course winner; retains ability but this may prove too competitive

runners.name: Go Vince Go
runners.spotlight: On a good mark on his 2yo best; retains ability and he has run with credit on his last two starts; each-way shout.
runners.comment: Well treated on his 2yo best; creditable runs in defeat on last two starts; each-way shout

runners.name: Anaisa
runners.spotlight: Listed win over C&D (good ground) last August; she hasn't looked ahead of the handicapper this year though and others are more appealing.
runners.comment: Listed win over C&D last August; handicapper in command so far this year

runners.name: Roberto Caro
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on this year's best, including a close fourth over C&D in April; has had the odd excuse since and he ran perfectly well over an inadequate 5f at York three weeks ago (not well drawn); a big run could be on the cards.
runners.comment: On a dangerous mark and ran well in his one visit to Ripon; big run could be on the cards

runners.name: Kats Bob
runners.spotlight: 4lb lower than when third of 15 in this race last year; yet to strike in 2026 but there have been some good runs along the way, including his last two starts; looks the likeliest to grab the far rail if the field split into two groups; one to consider.
runners.comment: 3rd here in 2025; yet to win this year but arrives in form and shouldn't be underestimated

runners.name: Dorney Lake
runners.spotlight: Took a while to exploit his drop in the weights but he won at Doncaster in July and went in again at Southwell nine days ago; 4lb higher in a better race but he has the rail draw to help.
runners.comment: Won two of his last four starts; creeping back up the weights but has the rail draw
runners.owner: Mrs C M Clarke, Foulrice Park Racing Ltd

runners.name: Mister Sox
runners.spotlight: Two C&D wins last year and he is now 5lb lower than for the second of them; needs to bounce back from some modest efforts but that's quite possible under these conditions.
runners.comment: Two C&D wins last year and now 5lb lower than for the latest; not at best more recently

runners.name: Tolstoy
runners.spotlight: Low-key return to turf at York (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; should be well treated but he comes with risks attached.
runners.comment: Low-key return to action at York last month; longer trips preferable nowadays

runners.name: Westmorian
runners.spotlight: 6-21 on AW as opposed to 0-16 on turf; the handicapper has been in command so far this year but he is edging down the weights and may yet come good on grass; refused to race in last season's Ayr Silver Cup.
runners.comment: 0-16 on turf; more realistically handicapped now but others still appeal more

runners.name: Vince L'Amour
runners.spotlight: 5f win here off 2lb higher in May; quiet afterwards until reviving with a second of six at Thirsk last week; has a C&D win on his record but rarely seen over 6f in recent times.
runners.comment: On a good mark and ran well at Thirsk last week; rarely seen over 6f these days

runners.name: Grant Wood
runners.spotlight: Impressive in this race in 2024 when rated 3lb higher; mixed bag this summer but his two best turf runs have come over C&D and this represents an ease in grade; can't rule out.
runners.comment: Won this race in 2024; on a good mark and this is easier than last time; high on the list

runners.name: Roach Power
runners.spotlight: In fine form in the second half of 2025, winning five times; ran his best race this season when fourth of six at Windsor (5f, good to soft) when last seen in June; on a winning mark but slower ground would be preferable.
runners.comment: Back to his last winning mark but slower ground would be preferable

races.race_name: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap

runners.name: Musical Touch
runners.spotlight: Improved performer this year, winning 6f handicaps at Southwell and York; only midfield back at York three weeks ago and he needs to take his form to a new level to come out on top today.
runners.comment: Improved performer this year, winning on AW and at York; only midfield latest; needs more

runners.name: Brighton Boy
runners.spotlight: 7f win at Thirsk in May and ran well over that trip at Chester two weeks later; not quite so good since and the drop to 6f isn't enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Has a squeak on this year's peak efforts but he'll need to raise his game back at 6f

runners.name: I'm Next
runners.spotlight: Two front-running 5f wins this summer; came up short in his hat-trick bid at Pontefract four weeks ago and this is just the second 6f run of his career; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Two 5f wins this summer but held off this mark last time and 6f is a query

runners.name: Flight Control
runners.spotlight: Has proved a bargain buy for connections, winning a 6f Doncaster novice on debut and showing progressive form in 7f handicaps this summer; latest York win came in a Class 4 and although he's on the up, he has more on his plate from 4lb out of the handicap.
runners.comment: Progressive 3yo but he has more to do back at 6f and from 4lb out of the handicap

runners.name: Aramram
runners.spotlight: Progressive handicapper last year; took form to a new level with a Listed win at Doncaster on his seasonal return and performed to a similar level when second in the Group 3 Abernant at Newmarket in April; Group 1 company was too much to handle at Royal Ascot and a mighty performance will be needed to defy his big weight back in a handicap (12lb higher than for his narrow Ascot win last October).
runners.comment: Group 1 company was too much last time; big weight to defy but should run his race

runners.name: Lord Roxby
runners.spotlight: In good form this year, winning a big-field handicap at York (6f, good) in May and adding a C&D handicap 12 days ago (good ground; Dark Cloud Rising second); up 5lb in a stronger race and it could find him out.
runners.comment: Beat Dark Cloud Rising over C&D 12 days ago; 5lb rise in stronger race could find him out
runners.owner: N Skinner D Jenkins J Glover

runners.name: Fortification
runners.spotlight: Sprang a 40-1 surprise on his stable debut at York (5f, good) in May and he showed better form in defeat on his next two starts (both at York; 5f and 6f on good ground); messed about at the start when disappointing at York seven weeks ago; still of major interest from a handicapping perspective judged on his run on June 13 and he's unexposed at 6f; contender.
runners.comment: Latest run can be forgiven and he had been a rapid improver for new yard beforehand

runners.name: Royal Zabeel
runners.spotlight: Listed winner (6f) on AW; showed himself to be smart on turf too with a 7f handicap win at Newmarket last month; wouldn't judge him harshly on his Bunbury Cup defeat five weeks ago, racing away from the main action and still in front 1f out; 4lb lower today and he looks a big player for last year's winning connections.
runners.comment: Listed winner on AW; running well on turf this summer too and he's one to take seriously

runners.name: It Just Takes Time
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; runner-up on this card 12 months ago; having a solid campaign but surprising if he was up to winning.
runners.comment: Conditions fine and ran well on this card 12 months ago; others have much stronger claims

runners.name: Fast Track Harry
runners.spotlight: Gelded prior to his reappearance and he started 2026 with a pair of AW wins; tougher going on turf this summer but he has been in deep races and his latest second at Ascot (6f, good to firm; cheekpieces first time) has worked out well; runs off the same mark and commands respect.
runners.comment: Latest Ascot second has worked out well; commands respect off the same mark

runners.name: Eye Of Dubai
runners.spotlight: His record over C&D reads 121 and he has slipped to a dangerous mark after three low-key runs in 2026; looks the type to revive soon but perhaps when faced with slower ground than he'll encounter today.
runners.comment: C&D record reads 121; well handicapped but would appeal more on slower ground

runners.name: Manila Scouse
runners.spotlight: 0-5 at Ripon but he has run well here; back near his best when seeing off 16 rivals at Ayr last month but a subsequent Hamilton run (5f) was underwhelming; still feasibly weighted despite being 1lb wrong but he is another who would make more appeal on a slower surface.
runners.comment: Beat 16 rivals when winning at Ayr last month; mark fair but he would prefer softer going

runners.name: Kodiac Thriller
runners.spotlight: Fared best of the stands' side group when second in this race 12 months ago; races off 3lb higher this time around but he confirmed his liking for the track with a C&D win in April and he was better than ever when beating 16 rivals at York (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago; high on the list.
runners.comment: 2nd in this race last year (best of stands' side group); career best latest; high on list

runners.name: Khafiz
runners.spotlight: Won twice in novice company (7f) for Roger Varian; yet to win a handicap but he has run two sound races (1m and 7f) for his new stable; returns to 6f for the first time since his debut and he should have enough pace to cope.
runners.comment: Yet to win a handicap but he's run two sound races for new yard this summer; drops in trip

runners.name: Dark Cloud Rising
runners.spotlight: Positives include a C&D record comprising a win and a second and he arrives in top form; whether he is quite well enough treated for a race of this nature remains to be seen though.
runners.comment: C&D record reads 12; arrives in top form but others may prove better treated

races.race_name: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap

runners.name: Swiped
runners.spotlight: Progressive since fitted with headgear and switched to handicaps, winning three times and second twice from five attempts; had next-time-out scorers behind in second/third when gaining latest win at Sandown (1m, good to firm) 22 days ago and a further 6lb rise seems unlikely to prevent a bold bid from this improving 3yo.
runners.comment: Progressive 3yo had next-time-out winners behind when making it 3-5 in handicaps latest

runners.name: Best Rate
runners.spotlight: In-form 4yo who won at Ascot and Pontefract (both 1m, good to firm) in July; another creditable effort when third (Jungle Ruler second) at Sandown (1m, good to firm again) 17 days ago; ought to be competitive again.
runners.comment: In-form 4yo who won twice last month and seems likely to give another good account

runners.name: Andesite
runners.spotlight: Ran really well when runner-up in two big-field handicaps at York (7f/1m, good) in June; back close to that form when fifth of 15 at Thirsk (7f, good) a fortnight ago; has claims but he's often held up (tends to start slowly) and this isn't the easiest course to make ground up.
runners.comment: Capable off this mark but 1-16 overall and suspicion he'll need things to drop right

runners.name: His Finest Hour
runners.spotlight: Successful over 1m2f at Newbury (good to firm) off this mark for Ian Williams last summer; creditable start for new yard after nine months off (had wind surgery) when third of five over 1m2f here (good) 12 days ago; entitled to build on that but 9.4f at Wolverhampton is the shortest trip he's tackled prior to this.
runners.comment: Creditable reappearance for new yard over 1m2f here recently but new trip an unknown

runners.name: Barley
runners.spotlight: Made the frame for the seventh consecutive time, albeit beaten 7l, when second of 14 at Redcar (1m, good to firm) a week ago; holds no secrets from the handicapper but ought to give another good account.
runners.comment: Made frame on last seven starts but holds no secrets from the handicapper

runners.name: Garden Oasis
runners.spotlight: Prolific winning veteran, including in this race in 2021 and 2022 (fourth to Capital Guarantee last year); went close to another C&D success last month and fair third at Pontefract (1m, good to firm) since.
runners.comment: Veteran who won this in 2021 and 2022; close second over C&D in July; fair third since

runners.name: Advance Twentyfive
runners.spotlight: Back to form from out of the blue in a first-time visor when getting off the mark at the 11th time of asking at Chester (extended 7f, good) five weeks ago; plenty went his way (got a dream run through on the inner after leaders went hard) and wouldn't be an obvious type to follow up.
runners.comment: Back to form with a bang in a visor when off mark latest but a 4lb rise may find him out

runners.name: High Point
runners.spotlight: Made all on his final start for Ross Burdon at Yarmouth (11.5f, soft) in June but has failed to beat a rival in two recent starts for new trainer Iain Jardine; can only be watched at present.
runners.comment: Made all at Yarmouth in June but hasn't beaten a rival in two subsequent runs for new yard

runners.name: Capital Guarantee
runners.spotlight: Back to winning ways at Thirsk (1m, good to firm) last month; only sixth off this mark at Redcar last Saturday but the fact he won this race off 2lb higher last year provides hope; draw could have been kinder.
runners.comment: Only sixth at Redcar last Saturday but he won this off 2lb higher last year

runners.name: Murashah
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo who was strong in the market when making light of a 560-day absence at Thirsk (7f, good) in May on his first outing for Ed Bethell; won going away in a style which suggests this step up to 1m could unlock more improvement; a further four-month break is of little concern given he goes so well fresh (also won on debut).
runners.comment: Made light of long absence over 7f in May on yard debut and should have more to come at 1m

races.race_name: Ashley Smith Memorial William Hill Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Clocker
runners.spotlight: Usually slowly away but she was able to dictate the pace and battled back well when winning at Hamilton (1m3f, good) last month; evens when creditable second of four at Leicester (1m4f, good to firm) 18 days later, beaten a neck with the front two drawing 15l clear; player off same mark today.
runners.comment: Won at Hamilton (1m3f, good) and creditable 2nd of four at Leicester (1m4f, good to firm)

runners.name: Blue Tulip
runners.spotlight: Heavy defeats to begin with, including on soft in her only turf race, but closer on handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) and she built on that with a win over the same C&D (16-1); travelled okay but got shuffled back and came wide from last place entering the straight when hitting the front late on in that 12-runner race 16 days ago, which offers the clear chance of better still to offset her 5lb rise.
runners.comment: Won 12-runner handicap at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) 16 days ago despite run of the race

runners.name: Talitha Rouge
runners.spotlight: Four starts, the best of which was her debut in May; while not beaten far on handicap debut at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm; second favourite) last time, she finished only sixth of seven after making most; back to 1m4f (tried it on second start) but others are more alluring.
runners.comment: While not beaten far on handicap debut at Sandown (1m2f; made most), she was only 6th of 7

runners.name: Skirt Around
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who failed to beat a rival in her two handicaps this term, running below her 2yo form; moves up from 1m2f in first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Five-race maiden who failed to beat a rival in two handicaps this term (1m2f); headgear on

races.race_name: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap

runners.name: Saxon Grace
runners.spotlight: Promising third at Hamilton (1m1f, good) a fortnight ago and confirmed herself an improved performer with a cosy win at Redcar (1m, good to firm) last week; unextended when following up at Beverley (8.4f, good to firm) on Thursday; 7lb higher today but she should stay and looks to have strong claims of completing her hat-trick.
runners.comment: Chasing a hat-trick after bloodless wins at Redcar and Beverley; obvious claims

runners.name: Woodleigh
runners.spotlight: Course winner (6f); wins at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) and Doncaster (1m, good to soft) this summer but he has come up short on his last three runs; needs more to take this.
runners.comment: Two wins this summer but his good run of form has stalled more recently

runners.name: Little Ted
runners.spotlight: Has three C&D wins to his name, including this race in 2023; retains ability but threw away a golden opportunity at Leicester last month and a subsequent Newcastle run was below his recent best too; minor money perhaps his best hope.
runners.comment: Won this race in 2023; retains ability but looking increasingly hard to win with

runners.name: Hijo De La Luna
runners.spotlight: Poor strike-rate but he arrives after a creditable third at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm) last month; likely one or two will have his measure today.
runners.comment: Poor strike-rate and opposable for win purposes despite a solid latest effort

runners.name: Riddikulus
runners.spotlight: Won two of her last three starts, both at Ripon over 1m4f and 1m2f; a 4lb rise for her latest win shouldn't be beyond her.
runners.comment: 1m4f/1m2f wins here last month; latest 4lb rise shouldn't be beyond her

runners.name: Magic Runner
runners.spotlight: Won twice on AW off higher marks over the winter; she has more to prove on turf but a big run wouldn't be a huge surprise.
runners.comment: Two AW wins this winter came off higher marks; more to prove on turf but not discounted

runners.name: Feliz Navidad
runners.spotlight: Modest form in three turf maidens at up to 8.4f this summer; could improve for the longer trip and switch to low-grade handicaps but this mark isn't an obvious gift on the evidence available.
runners.comment: Up in trip for handicap debut so could leave his modest maiden form well beehind

runners.name: Tiberio Force
runners.spotlight: Finished third in this race 12 months ago (seven ran) before winning over C&D nine days later; unplaced in four runs this year and others look stronger.
runners.comment: C&D win last August but not fired on his last three starts; others look safer

runners.name: Horwich
runners.spotlight: Dropped a long way in the weights since joining Ruth Carr but he retains some ability and this longer trip looks worth exploring; drawn wide but likely to be dropped in; could go well at a price.
runners.comment: Tumbling down the weights; new trip looks worth exploring; could go well at a price

runners.name: Kitsune Power
runners.spotlight: Successful at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) last month and that has been followed by two solid runs, the latest at Beverley on Tuesday; one of three runners for Tim Easterby.
runners.comment: Beverley win (1m2f) last month has been followed by two creditable efforts; yard run three

runners.name: Sunny Orange
runners.spotlight: Off the mark for the year at Beverley (8.4f, good to firm) in April and he has run several good races in defeat since; he should be in the thick of the action once more.
runners.comment: Series of good runs since his Beverley win in April; should be in the shake up again

runners.name: War And Love
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden; hopes appear to rest on this first crack at 1m2f sparking some progress.
runners.comment: Eight-race maiden; hopes appear to rest on this first crack at 1m2f sparking some progress

runners.name: Casilli
runners.spotlight: C&D winner but it has been over four years since she last put her head in front; retained ability last summer but she has been absent for 366 days and others look safer.
runners.comment: C&D winner; last win came in July 2022 and she's best watched after a year out

races.race_name: Betway Boosts EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Al Qayed
runners.spotlight: 100,000gns yearling; second foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Queen's Best (1m2f Group 3; dam of 1m2f BC Filly & Mare Turf winner Queen's Trust) and Reverie Solitaire (1m4f Listed), out of 7f Group 3 winner; yard's superstar racehorse Baaeed was off the mark on Wednesday, for the Gosdens, with just his third runner as a sire; this stable will be keen to join the party and market clues invaluable.
runners.comment: 100,000gns yearling; yard's superstar Baaeed recently off the mark as a sire; market key

runners.name: Bin Jahwar
runners.spotlight: By Ghaiyyath; eighth foal; closely related to Group-placed 1m 2yo winner Turgenev (including AW; RPR 113), half-brother to three winners including Manobo (1m2f-1m7f including Group 2; 115) and Tagabawa (8.6f 2yo/1m4f AW; 98); dam 1m-1m2f winner (including 2yo/Group 2; 116); leading yard has a strong hand with its juveniles and this one holds a Royal Lodge entry.
runners.comment: By Ghaiyyath; leading yard has a strong hand with its juveniles; holds a Royal Lodge entry

runners.name: Waaqed
runners.spotlight: 150,000gns breeze-up purchase in April; Frankel second foal; dam 7f/1m winner (including 2yo/AW/Listed; RPR 108), sister to smart 1m-1m4f winner Secret State, half-sister to US Grade 1 BC Juvenile Turf winner Line Of Duty, out of disqualified 1,000 Guineas winner Jacqueline Quest; plenty of appeal on paper and the betting should prove informative.
runners.comment: 150,000gns breeze-up purchase in April; plenty of appeal on paper; betting informative

races.race_name: Betway Grey Horse Handicap

runners.name: Cayman Tai
runners.spotlight: Yet to win a turf handicap and he was only ninth of 11 in this race last year; ran well when fifth of 17 at York over 5f last month but surprisingly found it happening too quickly over 6f at Brighton last Friday; others hold more interesting claims.
runners.comment: Yet to win turf handicap; only 9th in this last year; others hold more interesting claims

runners.name: Strike
runners.spotlight: He has contested this race for the last four years, with form figures reading 1626; mostly running with credit this term and he narrowly prevailed at Newbury (6f, good to firm) five weeks ago; 3lb nudge shouldn't stop him being competitive under Billy Loughnane; player.
runners.comment: Form figures in this race read 1626; won last start and Billy Loughnane rides; player
runners.owner: S Emmet And Miss R Emmet

runners.name: Havana Blue
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mostly over 7f; on a two-year losing spell but he's finished runner-up on his last three outings, including when dropped back to 6f here (good to firm) last Friday; races from the same mark and this previous course winner looks sure to be involved.
runners.comment: Runner-up last three starts; same mark as latest and looks sure to be involved

runners.name: Nevasca Cinza
runners.spotlight: 0-7 but he's yet to finish out of the frame; recorded his best effort for this yard when third in 5f Ffos Las maiden (good; first-time visor) one month ago; this return to 6f looks a positive move for his handicap debut.
runners.comment: Best run for yard when third over 5f latest; return to 6f can suit; handicap debut

runners.name: Act Of Violence
runners.spotlight: He had been upset in the stalls when unable to justify favouritism on his stable debut in June but made no mistake when making all under Silvestre De Sousa at Ripon (6f, good) four weeks ago; 8lb rise still leaves him well treated on old form and he's of firm interest.
runners.comment: Second start for yard when winning well latest; of firm interest

runners.name: Secret Guest
runners.spotlight: Sole start here saw him finish eighth in the 2023 edition of this; picked up a Thirsk handicap last May but no wins since and his last two efforts have been modest, albeit he fluffed the start last time; career-low mark.
runners.comment: No win since last May and last two efforts have been modest; career-low mark

runners.name: Fancy Dancer
runners.spotlight: Dual turf winner who normally plies her trade in a lower grade and her second of six a fortnight ago came in a classified event; 7lb out of the handicap and will likely find this too tall an order.
runners.comment: 7lb out of the handicap and will likely find this too tall an order

runners.name: Maelstrom
runners.spotlight: Completed a 6f hat-trick last spring but signed off for William Haggas with last of 13 at Newcastle in November; had been gelded before racing too freely on his stable debut/reappearance 19 days ago; that should have knocked some freshness out of him and he's back on his last winning mark.
runners.comment: Raced too freely on stable debut/reappearance; could step forward off last winning mark

runners.name: First Folio
runners.spotlight: Only beaten 1l when fourth in this in 2024; no wins last year and he weakened to finish 5l behind Archduke Ferdinand at Redcar last time; continues to edge down the weights.
runners.comment: 5l behind Archduke Ferdinand at Redcar last time; continues to edge down the weights

runners.name: Archduke Ferdinand
runners.spotlight: He was 4lb lower when beating Strike to take this race in 2024; could only finish fifth last year but he took advantage of a reduced mark to score at Redcar (6f, good to firm; First Folio fourth) 17 days ago; back up 5lb but he should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Won this in 2024; reduced mark when winnning lates; up 5lb but he should be thereabouts

races.race_name: Betway Bet £10 Get £40 Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Queen Roslyn
runners.spotlight: Progressed from a low base last July/September, winning at up to 2m; quiet on her first two starts this summer following wind surgery, but she was back in the groove when second of 13 at York (extended 2m, good to firm; first-time tongue-tie) three weeks ago; tackles a classier event this time but can't be dismissed.
runners.comment: Back in form when second latest; tackles a classier event this time but can't be dismissed

runners.name: Alma Latina
runners.spotlight: Unraced at two; off the mark on third start when taking 1m2f Pontefract maiden with authority in June; similar form when third on handicap debut at Epsom (1m4f, good) one month later and her latest outing, when she disappointed over this trip at Sandown, came in a messy three-runner affair; cheekpieces go on and she's not one to give up on.
runners.comment: Disappointment last time came in messy affair; cheekpieces go on and not one to give up on

runners.name: Dojin
runners.spotlight: She recorded two AW handicap wins by a neck in the spring; raced freely when well-held second of five over C&D in June but back on track with solid third off this mark at Ascot (1m4f, good to firm) five weeks ago; new hood is probably a good addition as she tackles this trip for a second time.
runners.comment: Back on track off this mark latest (1m4f); new hood a good addition on second go at 1m6f

runners.name: Reem Rak
runners.spotlight: Relished the step up to this sort of trip when she obliterated three-runner Doncaster handicap seven weeks ago; impossible to accurately assess what she achieved that day but the handicapper came up with a 10lb jolt of improvement; fascinating to see what comes next.
runners.comment: Hard to assess 14.5f romp last time; 10lb rise and fascinating to see what comes next

runners.name: Hello Friend
runners.spotlight: Very similar form in three 1m4f novices (AW/good) and she bustled up a subsequent handicap winner on the second of them at Thirsk in June; goes up in trip for her handicap debut and she's one to consider.
runners.comment: Similar form in three 1m4f novices (AW/good); up in trip for h'cap debut; one to consider

races.race_name: Betway Bet The Responsible Way Fillies' Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Fire Thunder
runners.spotlight: Halted a run of seconds when justifying short odds at Lingfield last month; shaped as though 7f would be well worth a go when fifth on her handicap debut here (again 6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; respected.
runners.comment: Shaped as though 7f would suit on her handicap debut here a fortnight ago; respected

runners.name: Cash Cove
runners.spotlight: Made good progress in her qualifying runs, including when landing 13-runnner maiden at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) in June; only third of four when favourite for her handicap debut at Chester next time but the pair that beat her have ran well subsequently and her wide stall was no help at Glorious Goodwood last time; could bounce back.
runners.comment: Beaten favourite on h'cap debut but form's worked out; excuse latest; could bounce back

runners.name: Princess Ivy
runners.spotlight: Improved when fourth at Newbury (form worked out) on her second start and she went very close at Windsor (also 6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; possibly a little unlucky that day and there's enough in her pedigree to suggest this new trip will suit; player on this handicap debut.
runners.comment: Possibly a little unlucky when close second last time; player up to 7f on handicap debut

runners.name: Eabha
runners.spotlight: She opened her account in 7f Epsom maiden last month and took it up a notch with a winning handicap debut over C&D (also good to firm) last Saturday; wasn't done any favours by the runner-up that day and a 5lb rise looks perfectly reasonable; might be the answer.
runners.comment: Did well to win h'cap debut over C&D last Saturday; up 5lb and she might be the answer

runners.name: Kodi Bear Light
runners.spotlight: All starts at 5f; Thirsk maiden winner who possibly had excuses when disappointing in Beverley's Hilary Needler next time; that wasn't the case when down the field again in Newbury's Super Sprint four weeks ago; jumps up two furlongs for this handicap debut.
runners.comment: Maiden winner who has struggled in two stiff tests since; jumps up 2f for handicap debut

races.race_name: Betway Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap

runners.name: Del Corso
runners.spotlight: He is on a hat-trick after making all (odds-on) in small-field handicaps at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm); handicapper hasn't been going overboard and he holds leading claims once again.
runners.comment: On a hat-trick after making all in small fields; mark still fine and holds leading claims

runners.name: Femme Beauty
runners.spotlight: Made virtually all when easily landing Ballinrobe claimer (9.5f, yielding; claimed for 15,000euros) for Ken Condon in June; handicapper was evidently watching so interesting to see what she makes of this career-high mark; one of two for Gerard O'Leary.
runners.comment: Made virtually all when easily landing claimer in June; mark suffered but still respected

runners.name: Dont Get Me Wrong
runners.spotlight: Joined this yard after winning a Dundalk claimer (7f, AW) in November but he's been uncompetitive in three subsequent handicaps, including at Roscommon (10.5f, good) in June; stable looks to have much stronger chances with Femme Beauty but he sports a new headgear combination so watch the market.
runners.comment: Uncompetitive in three handicaps but sports new headgear combination so watch the market

runners.name: Pipily
runners.spotlight: Showed a bit on her third start at two and, after a quiet handicap debut in June, she was always front rank before being picked off late over C&D (good to firm) four weeks ago; player up 3lb.
runners.comment: Always front rank before picked off late over C&D (good to firm) four weeks ago; player

races.race_name: Betway Free Bet Club Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Lightning Glory
runners.spotlight: Unraced at two; six-race maiden but in the frame all starts, including when second of nine at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW) a fortnight ago; 1lb nudge a little gratuitous but she's firmly in calculations.
runners.comment: In the frame all starts, including when second (8.5f, AW) a fortnight ago; in calculations
runners.owner: Duaij Al Khalifa & Ahmad Al Qassimi

runners.name: Stormy Music
runners.spotlight: Gradual improvement across her five starts culminated with a handicap win over C&D (good to firm) under Alfie Redman last Thursday; now 4lb higher but it's highly likely we've yet to see the best of her; key contender.
runners.comment: Gradual improvement culminated with recent C&D h'cap win; key contender

runners.name: Hamda's Joy
runners.spotlight: 0-5 but she's never been out of the first three and went fairly close when third of 12 in Southwell novice (7f, AW) six weeks ago; shaped that day like the step up to this trip will suit; makes her turf and handicap debut.
runners.comment: Not out of the first three, went fairly close latest (7f); 1m can suit; turf/h'cap debut

runners.name: Lovers Leap
runners.spotlight: Found a weak maiden when off the mark at long odds-on in May; hasn't quite matched that in two subsequent handicaps (7f) but this return to a longer trip looks a positive; possibilities.
runners.comment: Maiden winner; h'cap form doesn't quite match but return to longer trip a positive; chance

runners.name: Renesmee
runners.spotlight: Versatile sort who was runner-up at Chester (12.3f, good) in May but she's not easy to predict and was tailed off in the Kensington Palace at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) in June; beaten over 12l when 50-1 here (7f) a fortnight ago and younger legs are likely to prevail.
runners.comment: Beaten over 12l when 50-1 here (7f) a fortnight ago and younger legs are likely to prevail

races.race_name: Watch Live Racing At Betway Handicap

runners.name: Norcross Brow
runners.spotlight: In cracking form since joining this yard and he was winning his third race from his last four starts when always in command at Haydock (7f, good) last Saturday; goes up another 5lb but he's progressing well.
runners.comment: Won third race from last four when always in command last Saturday; progressing very well

runners.name: Cherry Cobbler
runners.spotlight: He was having just his second start on turf when a ready winner at the other Newmarket track (7f, good) in May; finished runner-up on his last three starts, twice over C&D including last time under Chloe Lyons, and now takes a drop in class; has to be considered.
runners.comment: Ready win on the Rowley (7f) in May; runner-up last three starts; drops in class; player

runners.name: Jersey Maverick
runners.spotlight: Fairly bolted up at Epsom (7f, good to firm) last July; that remains his only success but he's generally been running well this term and the handicapper is starting to give him a chance; respected.
runners.comment: Epsom win last July is his only success but generally running well this term; respected
runners.owner: Tim Cottier, Clark, Spence And Fellowes

runners.name: Mister Mojito
runners.spotlight: It was a fourth AW success when scoring at Lingfield (7f) last Tuesday, but he knows how to get it done on turf too and his previous second of six over C&D (good to firm) was a creditable effort; has won off this mark and Billy Loughnane takes over; player.
runners.comment: AW win latest but does it on turf too; won off this mark and Loughnane takes over; chance

runners.name: Electrical
runners.spotlight: He hasn't been able to replicate his 2yo form in handicaps this year and was beaten a long way when fifth of six over C&D a fortnight ago; very hard to fancy at present.
runners.comment: Struggling in handicaps this year; beaten a long way when fifth of six over C&D latest

runners.name: Aspull
runners.spotlight: Started out by recording useful form on first three starts for Clive Cox but the wheels came off subsequently; 150-1 for his stable debut when weakening to be beaten 15l over 6f here last Friday; big transformation required just eight days on but slipping mark makes him worth a market check.
runners.comment: 150-1 for his stable debut when weakening to be beaten 15l over 6f here last Friday

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden

runners.name: Institute
runners.spotlight: Placings last autumn included over C&D; hasn't improved this year but wasn't beaten far in Curragh handicap; recent Navan maiden fourth was a good bit below best; should be thereabouts but possibly vulnerable.
runners.comment: Hasn't trained on as hoped but nonetheless should be thereabouts on overall profile
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Nebrook Star
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise in Britain at two; not beaten too far on yard debut last month in Curragh handicap despite slow start; more needed however back in maiden company.
runners.comment: Some merit in recent yard debut and seasonal return in handicap; more needed

runners.name: White Smoke
runners.spotlight: Experienced filly began the season on a rating of 80, having twice finished second in Curragh 2yo maidens; regressive this season though and needs to bounce back; good draw.
runners.comment: Regressive this season and needs to bounce back; good draw

runners.name: Beach Barbie
runners.spotlight: Three runs here in the spring were ordinary enough when never really competitive; can't rule out on return but looks a more likely one for handicaps.
runners.comment: Can't rule out on return but looks a more likely one for handicaps
runners.owner: N W T Dalzell & Edward Lynam

runners.name: Eager Lad
runners.spotlight: 15,000euros yearling; Mehmas colt; half-brother to winners Geometrical (Group-placed 7.5f/1m) and Slaney Tide (1m2f); dam unraced half-sister to smart 1m/1m2f winner King's Gambit, out of sister to 1m Group 1 winner Sophisticat; trip sharp on pedigree.
runners.comment: Mehmas colt; trip sharp on pedigree

runners.name: Osterode
runners.spotlight: Sister to Group 3-winning sprinter Ostraka and half-sister to 5f/6f winner Charlemont; dam Listed-placed 5f winner, is half-sister to 6f Group 3 winner Osterhase; visored when shaping with definite promise on Cork debut in June, weakening late on when fourth (third won next time); better for that and could play a major role here.
runners.comment: Speedily-bred filly showed enough debut promise in June to make her a definite player here

runners.name: Optics
runners.spotlight: No impact on sole 2yo run in 7f heavy ground maiden at Listowel and early speed on return at Cork last month, weakening into midfield; drops in trip and tongue-tie tried.
runners.comment: Early speed on return at Cork last month; drops in trip and tongue-tie tried

runners.name: Off We Go
runners.spotlight: Ducked right at start when well held in maidens at the Curragh and Navan; headgear combination now fitted and seems best watched.
runners.comment: Ducked right at start when well held in both maidens; headgear combination now fitted

runners.name: Strikepoint
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to yard's smart 7f/8f performer Indigo Five; didn't count last month in 6f maidens at Navan and Cork; drop back in trip unlikely to suit and eligible for a mark after this.
runners.comment: Didn't count last month in 6f maidens; drop in trip unlikely to suit

runners.name: Grande Cuvee
runners.spotlight: Sister to Listed-winning sprinter Grand Marques; keen enough on both maiden runs in the spring, second occasion not quite getting home over stiff finish at Navan when third (second won next time and now rated 90); that looks decent form and could well play a major role here.
runners.comment: Navan third is looking decent form, could well play a major role

runners.name: Forbidden
runners.spotlight: Big odds, soundly beaten twice in Curragh maidens in June; back in trip and seems best watched.
runners.comment: Big odds, soundly beaten twice in Curragh maidens in June; back in trip

runners.name: McHenry Sunrise
runners.spotlight: Shaped okay on second start last season in Navan maiden, not so good on comeback run at Cork in June; seems the lesser likely of the Stack pair and draw far from ideal.
runners.comment: Seems the lesser likely of the Stack pair and draw far from ideal

races.race_name: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Tosca No Candis
runners.spotlight: Blue Point filly has been highly tried the last twice, staying on fifth (beaten 3.5l) in Naas Listed and outclassed in Group 3 Silver Flash at Leopardstown last month (7f); drops in trip for first run in maiden company so has to be respected.
runners.comment: Naas Listed fifth gives her strong claims on first run in maiden company

runners.name: Hip Hop Chrissy
runners.spotlight: Second in Naas barrier trial in May before satisfactory debut five days later when third in Listowel maiden; didn't improve on that when beaten favourite in Bellewstown auction maiden (albeit winner won again next time), never really overcoming a slow start over 5f; return to 6f to suit and tongue-tie tried; draw a negative.
runners.comment: Return to 6f to suit and tongue-tie tried; draw a negative
runners.owner: Eclipse T'bred Partners/Gaynor Bloodstock LLC/F Gallagher

runners.name: Sadie Rose
runners.spotlight: Dandy Man filly cost 3,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to Qatari 6f-1m winner Mister Staple (inc 2yo); dam French 8.5f/1m1f AW winner (RPR 97), out of 7f 2yo/1m winning sister to Cheveley Park winner Magical Romance; headgear combination on for debut.
runners.comment: Cheaply bought Dandy Man filly; headgear combination on for debut

runners.name: Crayons In The Sky
runners.spotlight: Promising debut in 6f Fairyhouse median sires series race last month when strong-finishing second after meeting trouble in running; week later showed good early speed in much better-class fillies' maiden over same C&D in finishing fourth; one to consider.
runners.comment: Two Fairyhouse efforts over this trip make her a definite player and good draw

runners.name: Lady's Court
runners.spotlight: Inns Of Court half-sister to winners Formidable Force (6f; RPR 86), Amaan (6f/7f inc 2yo/Bahrain; 86) and Karnavaal (7f; 85); dam twice-raced (62) sister to US 1m3f Grade 1 winner Prince Arch; debutante probably all the better for the experience.
runners.comment: Debutante probably all the better for the experience

runners.name: Moyanna Castle
runners.spotlight: Magna Grecia half-sister to winners Catalyse (6f 2yo; RPR 87) and Toosha (German 6f AW); dam placed 6f 2yo (67), closely related to 11.6f Listed winner Kilimanjaro; newcomer best watched.
runners.comment: Newcomer best watched

runners.name: Cloughleagh Bridge
runners.spotlight: Recent Sligo fourth (6f, yielding) a step in the right direction but more required here.
runners.comment: Recent Sligo fourth (6f, yielding) a step in the right direction but more required here

runners.name: Scarlet Dream
runners.spotlight: 37,000euros yearling; dam 1m2f winner (inc AW; RPR 96), half-sister to 7f/1m Listed winner Shuwari, out of US 1m1f Grade 3 winner, is granddaughter of 1m1f winning half-sister to Champion Hurdle winner Annie Power; seventh of ten in a Naas barrier trial (behind Hip Hop Chrissy) in May.
runners.comment: Seventh of ten in a Naas barrier trial (behind Hip Hop Chrissy) in May

runners.name: Step In Style
runners.spotlight: Bayside Boy filly a 30,000gns foal; second foal; half-sister to Italian 5.5f/6f winner Invincible Ronaldo (inc 2yo); dam French 6f-1m 2yo winner, out of 6f 2yo Listed winner; market likely best guide on debut.
runners.comment: Half-sister to Italian sprint winner Invincible Ronaldo; market likely best guide on debut

runners.name: Mount Pinatubo
runners.spotlight: Pinatubo filly cost 32,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to winners Arkendale (1m; RPR 89) and Ajdayet (8.6f AW; 83); dam 1m2f-1m4f maiden (71), half-sister to 7f 2yo Group 1 winner Intense Focus; debutante probably best watched unless market speaks.
runners.comment: Pinatubo filly; debutante probably best watched unless market speaks

runners.name: Ana Morello
runners.spotlight: Bayside Boy filly a 15,000euros yearling; first foal; dam 9.5f AW winner, is sister to 2yo Group 3 winner/1m Group 1-placed Marie's Diamond; green, never featured but some late headway on last month's Gowran debut (7f); better for that experience but not sure this drop in trip will suit.
runners.comment: Late headway on Gowran debut; better for that but not sure this drop in trip will suit

runners.name: Starlit
runners.spotlight: Starman filly cost 38,000euros as a yearling; third foal; dam unplaced over 5f, closely related to French 1m/1m4f winner Bolt Of Thunder, half-sister to 5f-7f winner Classy Clarets; slow to break, some late headway under considerate handling on debut into midfield in very valuable Ballyhane Stakes at Naas early this month; entitled to improve for that.
runners.comment: Some debut promise at Naas after tardy start; entitled to improve for that

runners.name: Outside Sun
runners.spotlight: Cheaply bought Twilight Sun filly never counted on recent Sligo debut when a 20-1 chance; best watched.
runners.comment: Never counted on recent Sligo debut when a 20-1 chance; best watched

runners.name: Rathbran Lady
runners.spotlight: 100-1, never sighted when towards rear in good-class Curragh fillies contest last Sunday; can only be watched.
runners.comment: Never sighted when towards rear in good-class Curragh fillies contest last Sunday

races.race_name: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap

runners.name: Allsortz
runners.spotlight: C&D maiden winner in April before adding Cork handicap over 5f; wasn't beaten far over same C&D last month on ground plenty quick; should appreciate return to 6f on this surface; likes to force it and has the ideal draw.
runners.comment: C&D maiden winner; return to 6f to suit and ideal draw for a front-runner

runners.name: I Bid You Ajou
runners.spotlight: Three-time Fairyhouse winner has been running well this season but yet to get his head in front, most recently faring best of those racing stands' side when chasing home a rapid improver at Naas last month; 0-5 on AW but close second over C&D in April when last seen here; definite player with rider's claim a positive.
runners.comment: Holding his form well on turf of late; definite player with rider's claim a positive

runners.name: Dark Ace
runners.spotlight: Five wins include twice over C&D and valuable Lingfield handicap in the spring; contesting premier turf handicaps of late, notably close third in Rockingham (Curragh), not clear run in the Ahonoora at Galway last time (7f); back to optimum trip now and one to consider.
runners.comment: Excuses at Galway; dual C&D winner back to optimum trip now and one to consider
runners.owner: J Fairhurst & Damian McCann & Cyril McMullan

runners.name: Valiant Force
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner at the track at 5f-8f, including 4-runner minor contest last winter; out of form on turf in first half of season and last month's AW return leaves him with a fair bit to find with some of these.
runners.comment: Last month's AW return leaves him with a fair bit to find with some of these
runners.owner: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar

runners.name: Kerdos
