runners.spotlight: Won four for Clive Cox, including the Group 2 Temple Stakes in 2024; first win since came here last month in 5f handicap (first-time blinkers) coming off strong pace to reel in long-time leader late on (Collective Power, Fox In Flight and Valiant Force behind); 5lb higher now but still on an okay mark.
runners.comment: Several of these behind when winning here last month (5f); likely big player again
runners.owner: Michael Scaife/Liam Ferguson/Simon Murphy/H S Khunkhuna

runners.name: Cuban Grey
runners.spotlight: Admirable sort whose seven wins include twice here over 5f, notably 0.5l defeat of Collective Power in April; arrives here on the back of two good runs over 5f at the Curragh but remains vulnerable at this trip.
runners.comment: Good turf form of late but best at 5f and remains vulnerable at this trip

runners.name: Sir Les Patterson
runners.spotlight: All five wins have come on the AW, including twice over C&D last winter; encouraging turf return at Newmarket in May hasn't been built on, cheekpieces tried last time now ditched; back on favoured surface but races off 15lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Better AW performer and dual C&D winner last winter; not at best on turf of late

runners.name: Fox In Flight
runners.spotlight: Won a 5f maiden here last December and several good runs in defeat since including Cork second and close fifth to Kerdos here last month (5f); never competitive in valuable Cork handicap latest when 3lb out of handicap; 4lb wrong here.
runners.comment: Goes well here but perhaps better at 5f; 4lb wrong here

runners.name: Collective Power
runners.spotlight: Six-time course winner (four at this trip) and has gone close a few times this year, including last month when strong-finishing third (beaten 0.75l) to Kerdos over 5f, having had to be switched; big player now at his more favoured trip.
runners.comment: Strong-finishing third to Kerdos over 5f; big player now at his optimum trip
runners.owner: Exors of the Late Mrs S Power

runners.name: Black Forza
runners.spotlight: Group 2 Richmond Stakes winner in 2024; sparingly raced last year, including third of 5 behind Valiant Force in 5f conditions event here; never sighted on seasonal return in Naas Listed in May and has had time off since (gelded); first-time headgear combination for handicap debut.
runners.comment: Gelded since no show at Naas in May; questions to answer on handicap debut

runners.name: All The Girls
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f maiden here last October but hasn't really gone on from that, much the best effort when third behind Cuban Grey here over 5f in May; soon beaten following month at Fairyhouse; back from a break and tough task from 7lb out of handicap.
runners.comment: Back from a break and tough task from 7lb out of handicap
runners.owner: Elaine Shevlin & Cormac Farrell & Ms Denise McCourt

runners.name: Dandyville
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner (from 7 career wins) but relatively lightly raced in recent years without success; absent for a year and starts off with a new trainer off much-reduced mark (3lb wrong).
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner; absent for a year and starts off with a new trainer off much-reduced mark

races.race_name: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden

runners.name: Punica Granatum
runners.spotlight: Good 2yo maiden form at this trip and just denied on seasonal return in valuable Curragh fillies handicap over 1m in May; clipped heels when unseating at Galway latest but on overall form has leading claims here; good draw too.
runners.comment: Clipped heels when unseating at Galway but on overall form has leading claims

runners.name: Little Sure Shot
runners.spotlight: Fine debut second at Leopardstown last summer hasn't been built on, although recent Fairyhouse third was a bit more encouraging; more needed.
runners.comment: Hasn't progressed at three; recent Fairyhouse run a bit more encouraging but more needed

runners.name: Trek Home
runners.spotlight: Hasn't finished outside the first four in five maiden starts, notably latest two in 6f maidens, beaten a short-head into third at Navan and ducked badly left in first-time cheekpieces (now discarded) when third at Cork last month; 7f trip an unknown but definite player if staying, despite wide draw.
runners.comment: 7f trip an unknown but definite player if staying, despite wide draw
runners.owner: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan

runners.name: She's Too Kool
runners.spotlight: Owes her high mark to finishing fourth in Group 3 Anglesey Stakes last year; not a bad effort on Fairyhouse comeback in June but later in month keen and lost a shoe when last in Curragh premier fillies' handicap; back from a break and has a bit to prove from outside draw.
runners.comment: Excuses when last seen; back from a break and has a bit to prove from outside draw

runners.name: Galavanting
runners.spotlight: Kameko half-sister to winners Space Tracker (6f-1m inc Australia; RPR 102), Qaaddim (1m AW 2yo/1m2f turf; 87) and Notturno Ligure (Italian 7f-1m2f); dam sprint maiden, half-sister to Listed-placed 5f-7.4f winner Colour Of Love; debutante for whom market best guide.
runners.comment: Debutante for whom market best guide

runners.name: Brigids Charm
runners.spotlight: Elzaam filly is first foal of a moderate maiden so little to excite on breeding.
runners.comment: Elzaam filly is first foal of a moderate maiden so little to excite on breeding

runners.name: Eldorado Glory
runners.spotlight: Cotai Glory half-brother to 1m5f turf/2m AW winner Elle Dorado Rock (RPR 69); dam 1m 2yo winner (71), half-sister to Group-placed 9.4f-11.4f winner Majeed; debutant for whom market best guide (rider has ridden a couple of winners this season).
runners.comment: Debutant for whom market best guide (rider has ridden a couple of winners this season)

runners.name: Hurleys Hill
runners.spotlight: Belardo gelding cost 7,000euros at the breeze-ups; brother to 1m winner Bellabel (inc 2yo/US turf Grade 2; RPR 114), half-brother to winners Sumptuary Law (1m-10.3f inc 2yo/AW; 90), Classic Design (9.4f AW; 82) and Key Look (7f/1m inc AW; 70); dam 8.6f AW winner (96); unlikely one to make an immediate impact but worth a market check.
runners.comment: Related to some decent types; worth a market check on debut

runners.name: Emiza
runners.spotlight: Blue Point filly closely related to 1m winner Embiran (RPR 94), half-sister to winners Elamaz (French/Australian 1m/1m2f inc Listed; 113), Emaniya (Group-placed 1m 2yo) and Ediyva (7f AW); dam 7f winner (inc Group 3/AW; 106); encouraging recent Naas debut fifth over 1m, having travelled well into the race; drop back in trip and first-time tongue tie could prove a shrewd move.
runners.comment: Promising debut over 1m; drop in trip and first-time tongue tie could prove a shrewd move
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Steppinoncats
runners.spotlight: Wings Of Eagles half-brother to six winners inc Sebastian Beach (1m4f/1m6f; RPR 88), Wefait (1m2f AW/11.4f turf; 83) and Dunmore Boy (5f/6f 2yo AW; 68); dam maiden half-sister to French 1,000 Guineas winner Danseuse Du Soir; bred to want further but upwardly mobile yard so don't rule out on debut.
runners.comment: Bred to want further but upwardly mobile yard so don't rule out on debut

runners.name: Aghadrum Boy
runners.spotlight: Modest effort on debut at Limerick last month when 22-1; may need more time and experience.
runners.comment: Modest effort on debut at Limerick last month when 22-1; may need more time

runners.name: Call The Cavalry
runners.spotlight: All four runs have been here earlier in the year, notably narrow defeat in 6f maiden and didn't seem to quite get home over today's trip; absent since below-par run over 5f in April.
runners.comment: Fair form here earlier in the year, 5f too sharp when last seen in April.

runners.name: Trovao Dourado
runners.spotlight: Never landed a blow over further in maidens at Down Royal and Leopardstown; eligible for a mark after this.
runners.comment: Never landed a blow over further in two maidens; eligible for a mark after this

runners.name: Strike De Vega
runners.spotlight: Two maiden runs in the spring were modest enough; likely to be of more interest in handicaps.
runners.comment: Two maiden runs in the spring modest enough; likely to be of more interest in handicaps

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden

runners.name: Alreem
runners.spotlight: Starman filly was sent off at 40-1 on debut at the Curragh and ran accordingly; may need a bit more time.
runners.comment: Starman filly soundly beaten at 40-1 on debut, may need more time

runners.name: Ile De France
runners.spotlight: Gun Runner colt one of three for top yard and preferred by Lordan; looked like he'd improve plenty for his promising debut run over 6f at Naas behind subsequent Group 2 winner Man's Best Friend when not knocked about and this longer trip should suit; leading claims.
runners.comment: Gun Runner colt, green but promising debut at Naas, should get 1m, leading chance

runners.name: Verona Basilica
runners.spotlight: St Mark's Basilica colt; half-brother to seven winners inc Serpentine (1m2f/1m4f inc Derby; RPR 121), Wedding Vow (1m1f Group 2; 113) and Beacon Rock (1m2f Group 3; 109); dam placed 7f-1m4f (including Oaks; 112); impeccably bred and no surprise to see a big run on debut.
runners.comment: St Mark's Basilica colt, half-brother to Derby winner Serpentine, likeable pedigree
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Moliere
runners.spotlight: Sent off at 50-1 on debut at Galway (7f, yielding) and wasn't disgraced, beaten 8.5l into fourth of 8; open to improvement but a fair bit more likely needed to take this.
runners.comment: Respectable debut when 50-1 at Galway, can improve but fair bit more likely needed here

runners.name: Bex Noir
runners.spotlight: Arizona filly; E3,000 yearling; half-sister to winners Corolla Point (5f inc 2yo; RPR 105) and Mullins Beach (6f; 67); dam unplaced 6f-1m AW (33), closely related to US 1m Grade 2 winner Istanford; likely best watched on debut.
runners.comment: E3,000 Arizona filly, half-sister to 2yo winner but likely best watched on debut

runners.name: Youveonlyonemother
runners.spotlight: Starman filly; unraced dam out of maiden close relative of smart 2m jumper My Mate Mozzie; best watched on debut.
runners.comment: Starman filly, dam from family of smart jumper My Mate Mozzie, best watched on debut

runners.name: Aachen
runners.spotlight: Gun Runner colt; half-brother to 6f 2yo winner Trojan Warrior (RPR 94); dam 7f 2yo Listed winner (104), half-sister to 1m1f Group 3 winner Red Riding Hood; one of three for top yard that has won the last four renewals; market can guide.
runners.comment: Gun Runner colt, dam 7f 2yo Listed winner, yard won last four renewals, check market
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Epic Arch
runners.spotlight: Epicenter colt was an 80,000USD yearling; closely related to US 6f/8.5f dirt winner Howling Time (inc 2yo), half-brother to US winners Air Recruit (5.5f-8.5f turf inc 2yo/stakes) and Basil Flavor (1m turf); dam US 8.3f AW/9.5f turf winner; plenty of appeal on paper.
runners.comment: 80,000USD Epicenter colt, related to 2yo winners, plenty of appeal on paper

runners.name: Highest Order
runners.spotlight: Dark Angel colt from a good family was sent off at 6-1 on debut at Leopardstown (1m, good) 23 days ago but was beaten 10.5l; major step forward needed.
runners.comment: Well-bred Dark Angel colt beaten 10.5l on debut, major step forward needed

runners.name: Magna Cum Laude
runners.spotlight: Flightline colt; 950,000USD yearling; half-brother to US Graded stakes-placed 1m dirt winner Blacksmith; dam unraced sister to US 7f Grade 2 winner Cezanne, closely related to US 6f stakes winner Counterforce; one of three for top yard; worth a market check on debut.
runners.comment: 950,000USD Flightline colt, half-brother to US 1m dirt winner, market can guide on debut

runners.name: Lusted
runners.spotlight: 66-1 and failed to beat a rival on debut at Leopardstown 23 days ago; others make more appeal.
runners.comment: 66-1 and failed to beat a rival at Leopardstown, others make more appeal

runners.name: Equus Victor
runners.spotlight: Blackbeard colt; slowly away and never landed a blow on debut over 5f on heavy at the Curragh in March; attracted market support that day so likely capable of better and has been gelded since; top rider booked and steps up markedly in trip.
runners.comment: 3-1 but well beaten on debut over 5f in March, gelded since, big step up in trip
runners.owner: Karl Kirwan & R P Behan & Mrs John Murphy & James Morgan

runners.name: King Paddy
runners.spotlight: 200-1 and never figured on debut at the Curragh six days ago; seems safe to rule out on that evidence.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten on debut at the Curragh when 200-1, seems safe to rule out

races.race_name: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap

runners.name: Cause I Like You
runners.spotlight: 3yo filly off the mark at Killarney a month ago (1m, good), staying on well to get up for a 1.75l win (Beau Army third); hiked up 7lb; held behind a couple of these on last AW run over C&D in April but arrives in form and this race could be run to suit; big chance.
runners.comment: Up 7lb for Killarney win, arrives in fine form and this race could be run to suit, claims

runners.name: Queen Leila
runners.spotlight: 3yo filly had the run of the race when getting a soft lead to score by 1.5l over C&D when last seen in April (Beau Army second); raised 5lb for that and may not get her own way out in front again here.
runners.comment: Had run of race when winning over C&D in April, up 5lb, may not get easy lead here

runners.name: Roman Harry
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f claimer here in December; ran well in C&D handicap on last visit to this venue in April and 1lb lower now; modest turf runs last twice and drawn wide on return to the AW.
runners.comment: 7f course winner, good run off 1lb higher over C&D in April but drawn wide here

runners.name: Bullet Bourbon
runners.spotlight: 3yo filly gained breakthrough win here a month ago over 7f when a 33-1 shot; just 3lb higher now and while she's drawn wide, she'll have the assistance of the champion jockey in the plate; however, stamina a query at this longer trip.
runners.comment: Breakthrough win over 7f here latest, up 3lb, drawn wide, stamina a query
runners.owner: David Daly & Gerard Shevlin & D Battersby

runners.name: Reponse Finale
runners.spotlight: Recovered from a sluggish start to shed the maiden tag at Gowran (9.5f, gd-fm) three days ago, her first start for this yard; carries a 7lb penalty, drops in trip and her previous runs here have been moderate; slow-starting, fast-finishing second over 1m at Cork on Friday.
runners.comment: Off the mark over 9.5f at Gowran and second at Cork on Friday; previous AW form moderate

runners.name: Rampage
runners.spotlight: Is 15lb lower than when winning over C&D last summer and took a step in the right direction when beaten 3.5l over C&D on latest; eased 3lb for that run and well-drawn here; could go well at a price.
runners.comment: Won over C&D last summer off 15lb higher, not beaten that far here latest, could go well
runners.owner: Mrs P McCourt/Whyte's Stamullen Syndicate/S Sweeney

runners.name: Master Garvey
runners.spotlight: Not easy to win with but often runs well in defeat; is 7lb lower than when winning over C&D in March 2025 but he's becoming difficult to predict; only midfield at Leopardstown on latest; others look more solid.
runners.comment: C&D winner off 7lb higher in 2025, not easy to predict, others arrive in better form
runners.owner: Patrick M O'Brien & Larry Murray & Derek Cummins

runners.name: Beau Army
runners.spotlight: 3yo filly made all to score by 4.25l at Gowran (7f, good) eight days ago in a first-time visor (retained); has won here over 6f and 7f and wasn't far behind Queen Leila over C&D in January; drawn to attack from stall 1 and a bold bid looks likely.
runners.comment: Made all at Gowran latest, has won here over 6f-7f, drawn to attack in stall 1

runners.name: Famous Enough
runners.spotlight: C&D winner has shaped as though turn was near the last twice; beaten a head by Movin And Groovin over C&D on penultimate off 2lb lower and beaten 1.25l when second of 18 at Naas (1m, good) on latest; should be thereabouts again.
runners.comment: C&D winner, gone close last twice, should be on the premises again

runners.name: Movin And Groovin
runners.spotlight: Back from a 429-day absence with a 25-1 win over C&D on stable bow last month (Famous Enough second); 4lb rise for that seems reasonable and can't be discounted but wide draw not ideal.
runners.comment: Up 4lb for stable debut C&D win after absence, chance but wide draw not ideal

runners.name: Tenacious
runners.spotlight: 3yo filly's standout effort came when a close third at Gowran in May but nowhere near that level in three runs since; hard to fancy right now.
runners.comment: Close third at Gowran in May, tailed off three starts since, hard to fancy right now

runners.name: Six Wings
runners.spotlight: 3yo filly 0-6 and yet to show winning potential; well held behind Cause I Like You and Beau Army at Killarney last time; blinkers now tried for AW debut; more needed.
runners.comment: 0-6, yet to display winning potential, blinkers go on for AW debut, much more needed

runners.name: Never Mind Me
runners.spotlight: Showed ability for Andrew Balding but sold cheaply in October 2024 and hasn't been seen since; best watched on stable debut.
runners.comment: Ability for Andrew Balding, not seen since 2024, best watched on stable debut

runners.name: Misava
runners.spotlight: No sign of winning potential in maidens for Noel Meade and heavy defeat on handicap and stable debut on seasonal return at Roscommon; still relatively early days but others preferred.
runners.comment: Heavy defeat on stable and handicap debut latest, still early days but others preferred

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap

runners.name: Quatre Bras
runners.spotlight: Two-time C&D winner, most recently last November off 2lb lower; running okay in defeat on turf in recent starts over inadequate trips and this hold up sort could get a nice pace to aim at on return to the AW; not out of this.
runners.comment: Two-time C&D winner, could get a nice pace to aim at here, not out of this

runners.name: Steel Cut
runners.spotlight: Best effort came in a C&D maiden in May when a 0.5l second to an 80 rated rival; ran respectably on handicap bow at Navan (1m2f, good) but struggled upped to 1m5f at Ballinrobe latest; drops back in trip now and the return to the AW is a plus.
runners.comment: Best run came in C&D maiden in May, 1m5f too far latest, return to AW a plus

runners.name: Nermal
runners.spotlight: Consistent 3yo placed in a 1m maiden here in January; yet to run a bad race this term; won at Roscommon in June (10.5f, good); another fine run when a close fourth at Galway over 12.5f latest; 3lb wrong here but should give another good account.
runners.comment: Consistent 3yo, fine run at Galway latest, has form here, 3lb wrong but can run well

runners.name: Crypto Force
runners.spotlight: Has lost way since winning at Gowran in July of last year; way below best on turf when last seen in April and has been gelded; cheekpieces tried now on first start since rejoining yard; probably best watched unless backed.
runners.comment: Out of form when last seen in April, gelded, new yard, cheekpieces on, watch unless backed

runners.name: Beauparc
runners.spotlight: Two-time course winner over 1m4f; remains 4lb above her most recent win here in March; shaped well over 1m5f at Down Royal on latest but this trip may be on the sharp side.
runners.comment: Two-time AW winner at 1m4f, decent turf run over 1m5f latest, this trip may be too sharp

runners.name: Iron Fist
runners.spotlight: Below par in heritage handicap at York on latest but previously ran well in defeat in a premier handicap at the Curragh; AW debutant is bred to act on this surface (half-brother to two AW winners and dam won on AW) so could bounce back.
runners.comment: Below par at York latest, AW debutant bred to act on this surface, could bounce back

runners.name: Cala Bonita
runners.spotlight: Boasts C&D form figures of 211; roared back to form with a win over 8.5f (yld-sft) at the Galway festival on latest; 7lb rise makes things tougher and this is harder but has to be respected given her fine record at this venue.
runners.comment: C&D form figures of 211, up 7lb for Galway win latest, respected given her record here

runners.name: Touch The Moon
runners.spotlight: Running okay without really threatening to win this season; not terrible efforts the last twice at the Curragh (1m2f, gd-fm) and on latest at Galway (1m4f, yld-sft) but probably needs a bit more help from the handicapper to get his head back in front.
runners.comment: Not terrible efforts the last twice, may need a bit more help from the handicapper

runners.name: Genoah
runners.spotlight: Solid AW strike rate of 4-8 including back-to-back wins here in the winter over this trip and 1m4f; is 5lb higher than when scoring over C&D in December and running okay on turf in recent starts; could go well back on his favourite surface.
runners.comment: 4-8 on AW, won off 5lb lower over C&D in Dec', could go well back on favourite surface

runners.name: Apercu
runners.spotlight: C&D win came in a maiden in 2023; a couple of decent runs this term but reportedly stopped very quickly when down the field at Leopardstown latest; is 2lb below her last turf win but was well held by Iron Fist at the Curragh in May and others more convincing.
runners.comment: C&D maiden winner, well held by Iron Fist at the Curragh in May, others more convincing

runners.name: Tribal Star
runners.spotlight: Both career wins have come here, the latest in this race last year off 1lb higher; has run well in defeat over much further on turf a couple of times this term and soft ground wouldn't have suited at Galway latest; should be doing his best work at the finish.
runners.comment: Won this last year, ground not ideal on latest, will be doing best work at finish

runners.name: Slieve Binnian
runners.spotlight: Rock solid record of 4-6 on AW including two wins over C&D; is 2lb lower than when last winning here in 2024 and wasn't disgraced when beaten 4.25l in a premier handicap at Leopardstown last month; interesting back at this venue.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner is 4-6 on AW, 2lb below last win, okay on turf latest, interesting

runners.name: Follow Me
runners.spotlight: Has come up dry since winning back-to-back races at the Curragh on first two starts for this stable in 2024; positive signs at Roscommon in cheekpieces on latest and now tries a visor for his AW debut; on a dangerous mark if taking to this surface.
runners.comment: On long losing run, positive signs latest, visor on for AW debut, on dangerous mark

runners.name: Star Harbour
runners.spotlight: Seven-time turf winner ran a nice race to finish second at Gowran earlier this week (12.5f, gd-fm): rated 4lb higher on this surface and while he's 0-17 on the AW, he's gone close on plenty of occasions off much higher marks; chance, once this doesn't come too soon.
runners.comment: Positive run at Gowran latest, lots of placed form here off much higher marks, chance

races.race_name: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap

runners.name: Rising Sky
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D in March and runs off the same mark here; however, soundly beaten on last three starts on turf so return to the AW needs to revive.
runners.comment: C&D win in March off this mark, below par on turf last thrice, needs to revive

runners.name: My Vonnie
runners.spotlight: Eighteen race maiden is 0-11 on the AW; soundly beaten on return from 128 days off over 1m here last month and the hood worn that day is left off; not easy to fancy.
runners.comment: 0-18 overall and 0-11 on AW, soundly beaten over 1m here latest, hood discarded

runners.name: Copper Craft
runners.spotlight: Went close at Navan last month (1m2f, good) before tailing off at Ballinrobe over 1m5f on latest; 0-4 on AW but yet to finish out of the first four; place chance if leaving that last run behind.
runners.comment: 0-4 on AW but yet to finish out of first four, poor on latest, place chance if rebounds

runners.name: Retro Gal
runners.spotlight: First sign of possible winning potential when a 5.75l fourth of 12 at Navan (1m2f, good) last month; 3yo eased 1lb and can challenge for place money if backing that last run up.
runners.comment: Decent fourth at Navan last time, 3yo eased 1lb, place claims if backing that last run up

runners.name: Shahada Ace
runners.spotlight: Bolted up at Tipperary last summer but form has nosedived since; slightly better at Gowran on latest but a bit to prove on AW debut.
runners.comment: Completely lost way since Tipperary win last summer, a bit to prove on AW debut

runners.name: Wingit
runners.spotlight: Ran her best race to date when a 7.5l second at Ballinrobe (1m5f, gd-yld) on penultimate but failed to build on that when a well beaten favourite at the Curragh; 0-5 on AW and others look more convincing.
runners.comment: Decent second at Ballinrobe but didn't build on it latest, 0-5 on AW, others preferred

runners.name: Anchors Away
runners.spotlight: Ran okay in a C&D maiden here in January but hasn't built on that; failed to beat a rival on last two starts; cheekpieces now added to tongue tie; questions to answer.
runners.comment: Ran okay in C&D maiden in Jan', failed to beat rival last twice, new headgear combo tried

runners.name: Storm Eric
runners.spotlight: Three wins here over 7f-1m but does stay this far and has multiple placed efforts over C&D; on a dangerous mark and a recent spin over hurdles at Wexford will have blown away any cobwebs; chance with rider taking off handy 7lb.
runners.comment: Three-time course winner goes well here, fit from recent run over timber, chance

runners.name: Tortola
runners.spotlight: Maiden whose best runs have come over 7f-1m; good second on debut for this yard at Bellewstown (1m, good) but bombed out at Killarney on latest (reportedly clinically abnormal post-race); a hood now goes on; risky.
runners.comment: Solid second on stable debut, excuse when bombed out at Killarney, hood on, risky

runners.name: Navajo Point
runners.spotlight: Maiden ran his best race to date when a 2l fourth of 14 here over 1m last month; didn't shape like he was crying out for further but his dam was placed over 1m4f here so not discounted.
runners.comment: Good fourth over 1m here latest, dam was placed here over 1m4f, not discounted

runners.name: Coul Dore
runners.spotlight: Fine run on second handicap start at Fairyhouse in June (1m2f, good); tailed off at Down Royal on latest when favourite but soft ground may not have suited; 3yo surely capable of better than that and too soon to write off.
runners.comment: Fine second at Fairyhouse, soft may not have suited latest, too soon to write off

runners.name: Threebiggulps
runners.spotlight: Huge odds and no show in maidens and similar story in first two handicaps; 2lb wrong; new hood needs to spark.
runners.comment: No impact in maidens or first two handicaps, 2lb wrong, hood now tried

runners.name: Dancing Steve
runners.spotlight: Two-time turf winner below best on grass so far this year and extended AW record to 0-8 when soundly beaten over 1m4f here last month; others arrive in better form.
runners.comment: Yet to hit form this season, 0-8 on the AW, others arrive in better fettle

runners.name: Barretstown
runners.spotlight: 4-24 on AW including three wins over C&D; is 4lb lower than when scoring here in September but his form in 2026 has been underwhelming so needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Three-time C&D winner but form this year well below best, needs to get back on track

races.race_name: Visit Perth Museum Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Biggles
runners.spotlight: Very useful on the Flat in his prime and returned from long absence with two encouraging hurdle runs for new stable this season, latterly when close fifth at Uttoxeter (2m, good) three weeks ago; that form already gives him good claims and he could quite plausibly have a bigger run in him.
runners.comment: Very useful on the Flat in prime; back from long layoff with two encouraging hurdle runs
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Lady Cobham

runners.name: St Just In Time
runners.spotlight: Lost out by only a short head on stable/handicap hurdle debut at Doncaster (2m, good to soft) in March 2025; that form puts him right in the thick of things here but he returned from a long absence with two disappointing AW runs this spring and needs to prove his wellbeing; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Went close on latest hurdling start in March 2025 but twice well beaten on AW this year

runners.name: Try Them
runners.spotlight: Left Emmet Mullins after a disappointing run in May but was back in good nick for new stable last month, going close in similar race to this over C&D (good); will play a major role if in similar form.
runners.comment: Went close over C&D on last month's stable debut; big player if in similar form

runners.name: Tracker Issue
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden on the Flat; outran triple-digit odds when respectable sixth (just behind Biggles) on hurdle debut at Uttoxeter (2m, good) three weeks ago but needs improvement.
runners.comment: Launched hurdling career with respectable sixth at triple-digit odds; more is needed

runners.name: Crackalackin
runners.spotlight: Fair Flat racer who posted the best of his three hurdle runs when second to a fairly useful rival at Huntington (2m, good to firm) in May; not seen since but enters calculations.
runners.comment: Second to fairly useful rival at Huntingdon in May; enters calculations

runners.name: C'Est Pour Moi
runners.spotlight: Not beaten that far when sixth of nine in good-ground Worcester bumper in June, his second start, but needs to take a big step forward on this hurdling debut.
runners.comment: Not beaten that far in his latest bumper but improvement is needed on hurdle debut

runners.name: Hawthorn Road
runners.spotlight: Showed only minor promise when 66-1 for hurdling debut over C&D (good to soft) three months ago; probably one for a bit further down the line.
runners.comment: Showed only minor promise over C&D on hurdle debut; one for further down the line

races.race_name: QuinnBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.name: Tamarind Bay
runners.spotlight: Switching to fences has reaped benefits, backing up his opening Stratford win with an authoritative display under 5lb claimer at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good; evens favourite); another 5lb higher today; Sean Bowen is back aboard; strong likelihood of better to come, and stable won this last year, so he is the one to beat.
runners.comment: Authoritative display at Uttoxeter (2m4f; evens) latest; 5lb higher; the one to beat.

runners.name: Ras Kassar
runners.spotlight: Regular winner in France for Joel Boisnard, including over fences at Loudeac (2m5f) and Meral (2m2f); has held his own since moving to the UK, second at Uttoxeter (2m4f; in a reapplied hood) three weeks ago; should prove capable of winning more races, but not necessarily this one.
runners.comment: Held own since moving to the UK, runner-up at Uttoxeter (2m4f) on latest outing.

runners.name: Kinbara Firstdraft
runners.spotlight: Won twice over hurdles for Stuart Crawford, latterly at Ayr (2m4f) in November 2024; has gone the wrong way and competes from 14lb out of the handicap on this fourth run for current trainer, having had wind surgery since latest; by far the least likely candidate.
runners.comment: Has gone the wrong way and is 14lb out of the handicap; first run since wind surgery

runners.name: Glen To Glen
runners.spotlight: In contention when running out at the last at Kilbeggan (2m4f) in June on final start for Joseph O'Brien, before leaving him for 50,000gns; cheekpieces added for this third start over fences (stable debut) and there's no denying that this former pretty useful Flat-racer possesses a fair chunk of ability.
runners.comment: Ran out at the last at Kilbeggan (2m4f) on final start for J O'Brien; 50,000gns purchase.

runners.name: Follow Your Luck
runners.spotlight: Point winner; maintained unbeaten rules record, landing the odds in a 2m4f novices' hurdle at Sedgefield (good to soft) in February; that form has been boosted by the runner-up (four wins since) who now has a mark of 128, so this one has claims going over fences from his opening mark of 124; likely to be a threat if fully primed.
runners.comment: Landed odds in 2m4f novices' hurdle at Sedgefield (good to soft) in February; chase debut.

races.race_name: IM Group Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Just Dottie
runners.spotlight: Four course wins (all over 2m); lacked the pace to challenge when third over that trip here (good; 4-1) early last month; finished down the field back on the Flat (1m2f) since; stablemate Follow Charlie has more to recommend.
runners.comment: Lacked pace when third over 2m here (good; 4-1) last month; stablemate of Follow Charlie.

runners.name: Struth
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner for Charlie Johnston (8.5f-12.5f); yet to score over hurdles (0-7) but doesn't have a massive amount to find with Lets Mingle and Summergrounds based on their recent C&D clash; the task isn't an impossible one.
runners.comment: Yet to score over hurdles (0-7); has C&D previous with Lets Mingle and Summergrounds.

runners.name: Follow Charlie
runners.spotlight: Back in trip, and readily resumed winning ways here (2m, good; 14-1) five weeks ago; that was in a Class 5 (0-105) so he has more on his plate in a 0-120 from this 6lb higher mark; one of two for Mike Smith, with Murray Dodd able to claim his full 5lb allowance this time.
runners.comment: Back in trip, and readily resumed winning ways here (2m; 14-1) five weeks ago; 6lb higher.

runners.name: Cosmic Soul
runners.spotlight: In fine form earlier this year, notching a hurdles hat-trick at Sedgefield (2m1f-2m4f; rising 16lb); reportedly stopped quickly when beaten favourite over 2m here (last of 12, beaten 42l) in June; it's possible that we might see the best version of this 6yo off a ten-week absence.
runners.comment: Notched hat-trick at Sedgefield; stopped quickly when beaten fav over 2m here latest.
runners.owner: M Lee, D Lee, C Jolley & Neville

runners.name: Lets Mingle
runners.spotlight: Said to have drawn benefit from the application of cheekpieces when game C&D winner (16-1; Summergrounds a close fourth) five weeks ago; boasts a solid C&D record (1U31) so a 2lb rise in the handicap could be manageable; one of three for Russell & Scudamore.
runners.comment: Game C&D winner (16-1; Summergrounds fourth) five weeks ago; 2lb rise could be manageable.

runners.name: Summergrounds
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in this last year, and again chased home Moonbow the following month; close fourth to Lets Mingle over C&D five weeks ago; is 2lb better off with that reopposing rival, and the 10lb claimer Ella McGarry takes over in the saddle; merits respect.
runners.comment: Close fourth to Lets Mingle over C&D five weeks ago; 2lb better off here; merits respect.

runners.name: Garde Des Champs
runners.spotlight: Infrequent winner (2-40); has plied his trade exclusively over fences since May 2024, lacking for fluency when runner-up to Conquer The Breeze here (2m) last month; monitor only, with Lets Mingle the pick of the Russell & Scudamore trio.
runners.comment: Plied trade exclusively over fences since May 2024; stablemate of Lets Mingle & Struth.

runners.name: O'Faolains Glory
runners.spotlight: Better over fences than hurdles, notching back-to-back Musselburgh chase wins (2m4f) last November/December; tough task in Carlisle Class 2 (beaten 38l) when last seen 146 days ago; this should bring her on with a return to fences (rated 5lb higher) likely.
runners.comment: Better over fences; this comeback run should bring her on, with a return to fences likely.

runners.name: Annie Agnew
runners.spotlight: Sole win came in a juvenile hurdle at Down Royal (2m1f) in September 2023; runner-up over 2m here (handicap debut) in July 2024, but all downhill since; soundly beaten when last seen three months ago; needs the added cheekpieces to spark a major revival; focus elsewhere.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten when last seen three months ago; needs cheekpieces to spark major revival.

races.race_name: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: October Hill
runners.spotlight: Cosy Ffos Las winner (2m4f, good to soft; from 2lb lower); it isn't easy to quantify that form, but she ran as well (if not slightly better based on RPRs) when runner-up in returning cheekpieces at Uttoxeter latest; back up in trip with Rian Corcoran's services retained; chance.
runners.comment: Cosy Ffos Las winner (2m4f, good to soft; from 2lb lower) in May; moves back up in trip.

runners.name: Drumlee Myth
runners.spotlight: Promise in bumpers; low key over hurdles until showing fine attitude when scoring at Cartmel (2m6f, good; 14-1) four weeks ago; that breakthrough win came after a year off so there's potentially more to come; 4lb rise seems fair so should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Fine attitude, successful at Cartmel (2m6f; 14-1) four weeks ago; player from 4lb higher.

runners.name: Magic Gloves
runners.spotlight: Fourth to Newport at Musselburgh (2m, soft; beaten 4l) last November; disappointing since, with no obvious uptick for wind surgery; handicap mark is in freefall and point win came over 3m, so there are some positives.
runners.comment: Disappointing this year (0-3), with no obvious uptick for wind surgery; easing mark.

runners.name: Broken Ice
runners.spotlight: Pounced late, ending barren spell, in this last year (neck winner off 102); didn't relish the Banks course at Punchestown in May, and nothing spectacular since over hurdles (2m1f-2m2f); returning to 3m is a positive, but he couldn't rate as the confident pick.
runners.comment: Pounced late, ending barren spell, in this last year (neck winner); below par since.

runners.name: Burgundy Man
runners.spotlight: Maiden over hurdles (0-21); nothing positive to draw upon since scoring over fences here (3m, soft; 7-2) last October; tailed off post wind surgery here (chase) 44 days ago; a risky proposition.
runners.comment: Maiden over hurdles (0-21); tailed off post wind surgery (chase) latest; risky proposition

runners.name: Dolly Dior
runners.spotlight: Proved her Hexham maiden win (2m4f; 50-1) was no fluke when chasing home the 119-rated Holy Joe over 2m4f here (novice; 15-2) five weeks ago; moves up in trip - stamina isn't totally obvious on pedigree - for handicap debut; low mileage.
runners.comment: Chased home 119-rated Holy Joe over 2m4f here (novice) five weeks ago; 3m for h'cap debut.

runners.name: Fortunes Dawn
runners.spotlight: Limited; was struggling with over a circuit to go when a remote third over 2m4f (novice; 250-1) five weeks ago; mountain to climb on handicap debut to even threaten to reverse placings with Dolly Dior.
runners.comment: Remote third over 2m4f (novice; 250-1) five weeks ago; mountain to climb with Dolly Dior.

runners.name: Dalileo
runners.spotlight: Came from off the pace to make it course win number five last month, brushing off a 6lb rise for his previous C&D win; the handicapper has taken another swipe (further 6lb rise) and this is the highest mark that he has competed from in over three years; a hat-trick is a possibility nevertheless.
runners.comment: The handicapper has taken another swipe (with a further 6lb rise) for latest C&D win.
runners.owner: Thp Racing & D A Harrison Racing

runners.name: Just Oot
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden; beaten favourite, no match for the winner, at Kelso (2m5f novice) in May 2025, before reportedly running flat on handicap debut at Hexham the following month; off since (for 427 days) so safest to let the market guide.
runners.comment: Ran flat on handicap debut at Hexham; off since (for 427 days); let the market guide.

runners.name: Ceol Draiochta
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish; first run for this trainer was respectable but pulled up in the 2m4f 0-120 won by Lets Mingle (runs earlier) here latest; this is an easier option, and he's 5lb lower, but with plenty to prove for the time being, not least stamina.
runners.comment: Pulled up over 2m4f here latest; plenty to prove for the time being, not least stamina.

runners.name: Quinnfinity
runners.spotlight: Pulled up on her first two starts (2m4f mares) and well beaten in a 2m maiden here (250-1) 44 days ago; makes handicap debut from 7lb wrong; younger stablemate of Burgundy Man.
runners.comment: Well beaten in a 2m maiden (250-1) here 44 days ago; makes handicap debut from 7lb wrong

races.race_name: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Nap Hand
runners.spotlight: No match for Filibustering when second at Cartmel (2m1f, good) on stable debut in June and has since been well beaten on the Flat but is well handicapped on some of his form for Alan King and will be suited by today's trip/ground; could have a say.
runners.comment: No match for Filibustering when second on stable debut but current mark is workable

runners.name: Scriabin
runners.spotlight: Off the mark over hurdles at 15th attempt, with hard-fought success in C&D (good) maiden six weeks ago; has more on his plate in this good-quality handicap, though, and needs to kick on again.
runners.comment: Gained hard-fought win in C&D maiden last month, his 15th hurdle run; more needed today

runners.name: Filibustering
runners.spotlight: Readily drew over 8l clear of Nap Hand to land good prize at Cartmel (2m1f, good) in June and is now 3-3 over hurdles since fitted with a tongue-tie in the spring; another 7lb higher but further progress is possible.
runners.comment: Landed good prize at Cartmel in June and is now 3-3 over hurdles since tongue tied

runners.name: Squeezebox
runners.spotlight: Fair Flat racer who won three of his first four hurdling starts and was creditable third in Summer Hurdle at Market Rasen (2m, good) on latest outing four weeks ago; not yet fully exposed over jumps; must be considered.
runners.comment: 3-5 over hurdles; placed off this mark in Summer Hurdle last month; must be considered

runners.name: Fidendum
runners.spotlight: 2-6 over hurdles, with both wins gained from the front at Market Rasen (2m, good) this season; not sure to get her own way in this higher grade but may still have potential; respected.
runners.comment: 2-6 over hurdles, with both wins gained from the front at Market Rasen this season

runners.name: The Last Cloud
runners.spotlight: Won three in a row over C&D (good) in early part of last season and subsequently made the frame in three Graded novice hurdles; absent since pulled up in Kelso Grade 2 in February but will be dangerous if back on song for this Perth return.
runners.comment: Won three times over C&D before showing smart novice form last season; off since February
runners.owner: B Hague, Mrs W Duffus & Partner

runners.name: Medieval Gold
runners.spotlight: Signed off for Micky Hammond with win at Carlisle (2m1f, soft) in November and was placed on both starts for new stable in February (2m1f/2m3f, good to soft); returns from 172-day break on career-high mark but is suited by this C&D and should be fine on the forecast good ground; cheekpieces (worn once on the Flat in 2023) are refitted; contender if fully tuned up.
runners.comment: Absent since placed twice for new stable in February but a possible if fully tuned up

runners.name: Pure Gold
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who was seemingly back in good form when close third in bunch-finish here (2m4f, good) five weeks ago; up in grade today but remains on a good mark; no surprise if she features.
runners.comment: C&D winner; seemingly back in good form over 2m4f here last month; still on good mark
runners.owner: Thp Racing & D A Harrison Racing

races.race_name: Brooks Macdonald Handicap Chase

runners.name: Shantou Show
runners.spotlight: Irish raider; without a win since 2023 and far too inconsistent to rely upon heavily but gave a good account when third off today's mark at Cartmel (3m1f, good) two starts ago and the booking of Sean Bowen catches the eye; reserve (non-runner) in the 5.40 at Tramore on Friday.
runners.comment: Far too inconsistent to rely upon heavily but booking of Sean Bowen catches the eye

runners.name: Button Rock
runners.spotlight: 0-6 over hurdles when trained by Gordon Elliott but finished well from poor position to cause 28-1 surprise here (2m4f, good) on stable/chase debut in six weeks ago; it's probably wise to treat that form with a degree of caution but today's step up in trip ought to suit him.
runners.comment: Finished well from poor position to cause 28-1 surprise here (2m4f) on stable/chase debut

runners.name: Mcgregors Charge
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on last month's stable debut at Newton Abbot (3m2f, good) but made a lot of the running before fading into fourth over that C&D (good to firm) in refitted cheekpieces and a first-time tongue a fortnight later, and it's worth remembering that his only career win came in this race in 2024; goes in just the tongue-tie today; interesting.
runners.comment: Second stable run was better than the first; won this race in 2024; interesting

runners.name: Le Malin
runners.spotlight: Absent for 571 days after winning at Down Royal (2m4f, good to yielding) on Boxing Day 2024 and was probably flattered by his proximity when last of three on last month's reappearance outing at Cartmel (3m1f, good), having set a slow pace for a long way; remains quite tricky to weigh up as a 12yo but that recent run might have brought him on.
runners.comment: Last of three last month, after a long layoff, and remains tricky to weigh up as a 12yo

runners.name: Collingham
runners.spotlight: Eight-time hurdle winner; generally disappointing for current stable since last summer but seemed to respond well to first-time visor when respectable fourth of 14 over fences at Uttoxeter (3m, good) three weeks ago; can feature if the new headgear continues to aid.
runners.comment: Stopped the rot with respectable fourth in first-time visor last month; not ruled out

runners.name: Edgewell
runners.spotlight: Made all for clearcut success at Worcester (2m7f,) last month and has now won four good-ground chases this year; should also be suited by this right-handed track but latest 6lb rise might leave him vulnerable.
runners.comment: Four chase wins this year; latest 6lb rise might be enough to leave him vulnerable

runners.name: Ballydangan
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner last year, latterly off today's mark at Hexham (3m, good to soft) in October; well beaten on last three appearances, though, and returns from five-month break with quite a bit to prove.
runners.comment: Dual chase winner in 2025 but out of form when last seen; returns from five-month break

races.race_name: Scone Palace International Horse Trials National Hunt Flat Race (Conditional/Amateur Jockeys') (GBB)

runners.name: Downtown Nashville
runners.spotlight: Former Irish pointer; unable to justify favoritism but didn't really enjoy the run of the race when third of 11 on rules debut at Uttoxeter (good) last month; stable does well in bumpers (23% strike-rate); ought to make his presence felt.
runners.comment: Didn't really enjoy run of the race when placed on last month's rules debut; respected

runners.name: Game Shadow
runners.spotlight: Made promising debut for Paul Power at Tramore (good; wore a hood) in May, keeping on from the rear for fourth; new stable has excellent 27% strike-rate in British bumpers; leading contender.
runners.comment: Promising fourth on debut at Tramore; new stable does well in British bumpers

runners.name: Dark Tide Rising
runners.spotlight: Out of a half-sister to a Listed Flat winner; failed to complete his first two Irish points but showed some promise when fourth in May (good to yielding), after which he changed hands for £10,000; market may guide.
runners.comment: Bought for £10,000 after Irish point fourth in May; market may guide on rules debut

runners.name: Captain Mainwaring
runners.spotlight: Out of a bumper/useful jumps winner; with a good stable but weakened into modest fifth of eight on debut at Ludlow (good) in November and needs improvement here.
runners.comment: With a good stable but was a modest fifth of eight on debut at Ludlow in November

races.race_name: Suit Direct At Meadowhall Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Qitaal
runners.spotlight: Winless since 2024 but in good form this season until last of six (in refitted cheekpieces) in 1m2f Epsom handicap 16 days ago; headgear is quickly dispensed with and this course scorer is the sort to bounce back.
runners.comment: In good form until last of six at Epsom latest; this course scorer is not written off

runners.name: Moonjid
runners.spotlight: Resumed winning ways at Yarmouth (1m2f) in June but he followed it with much lesser efforts in 1m2f handicaps at Windsor and Pontefract; others are preferred.
runners.comment: Won at Yarmouth in June but much lesser efforts at Windsor and Pontefract have followed

runners.name: Amidst The Chaos
runners.spotlight: Gained a first win of 2026 at Pontefract (1m) in June but he beat only one in 1m Redcar handicap a week ago; much more is required from this course scorer.
runners.comment: First win of 2026 at Pontefract in June but beat only one in 1m Redcar handicap a week ago

runners.name: Canvas
runners.spotlight: A two-time 1m winner here in 2025; made a promising return when fourth at Newmarket in May but well held in 1m handicaps at Carlisle and York since; has a bit to prove now.
runners.comment: Promising return when fourth at Newmarket but well held both runs since; bit to prove now

runners.name: Echalar
runners.spotlight: Kickstarted 2026 with breakthrough victory at Wolverhampton (7f) in January for Jane Chapple-Hyam; in decent form since for current yard until only seventh in 1m2f handicap at Chester 13 days ago; needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: In decent form until seventh in 1m2f handicap at Chester 13 days ago; needs to bounce back

runners.name: Poet's Dawn
runners.spotlight: Veteran who is enjoying a fine season and bagged win number five when completing a hat-trick in 1m2f handicap at Ripon 12 days ago; this likeable front runner merits serious consideration nudged up 1lb.
runners.comment: Win number five of 2026 when completing a hat-trick at Ripon; merits serious consideration

runners.name: Project Geofin
runners.spotlight: Failed to go on from his reappearance when only tenth in 1m4f York handicap in May; has since undergone wind surgery though so last year's winner can't be discounted now back off the same mark.
runners.comment: Took this 12 months ago; had wind op since tenth at York in May so not discounted

races.race_name: Skopes At Meadowhall Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: One Of The Boys
runners.spotlight: Fair form when placed over 7f on all three outings, latest when third in Wolverhampton maiden 29 days ago; that form is working out well so he holds leading claims; cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Good third at Wolverhampton latest (form working out well); holds leading form claims

runners.name: Wuood
runners.spotlight: 5-1, made a promising start when second of four in 1m novice at Newcastle in March; off since but this son of Night Of Thunder remains with potential and must enter calculations with yard going well.
runners.comment: Promising start with Newcastle second in March; off since but must enter calculations

runners.name: Cercis
runners.spotlight: Hooded and took a big step forward from her debut (for Ed Walker) when fourth of eight in 6f Nottingham maiden 25 days ago; this daughter of Kodiac may do better still.
runners.comment: Step forward with fourth at Nottingham 25 days ago; this Kodiac filly may do better still

runners.name: Hope And Joy
runners.spotlight: Has offered little in his three runs to date; off ten months before coming in eighth of nine in 7f Wolverhampton novice last month; hard to warm to.
runners.comment: Off ten months before eighth in 7f Wolverhampton novice last month; hard to warm to

races.race_name: Meadowhall X Flannels Beauty Bar EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Noble Prince
runners.spotlight: 9-2, shaped well when fourth of six in novice at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) on his debut 18 days ago, running on late under hand riding; this son of Frankel looks to have a fair bit more to offer; big shout.
runners.comment: Shaped well when debut Yarmouth fourth; this son of Frankel has more to offer; big shout

runners.name: Son Of A Fish
runners.spotlight: 28-1, never-dangerous fifth of ten in 7f AW novice at Lingfield on his debut last month; this Territories colt can build on it here.
runners.comment: Fifth of ten at Lingfield on his debut last month; this Territories colt can build on it

runners.name: Iwasjustsaying
runners.spotlight: 68,000gns yearling; half-brother to four winners, notably Embesto (1m Group 3; RPR 113) and Silent Film (7f-1m; RPR 105); dam French 5f-6.5f Group 3 winner (RPR 108); this Ghaiyyath colt holds a Group 2 Royal Lodge entry so rates an interesting newcomer.
runners.comment: This Ghaiyyath colt holds a Group 2 Royal Lodge entry so rates an interesting newcomer

runners.name: Minzazi
runners.spotlight: 10-1 and green when a debut seventh of eight in 7f Kempton novice ten days ago; this Minzaal colt can take a step forward.
runners.comment: Green when debut seventh at Kempton recently; this Minzaal colt can take a step forward

races.race_name: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap

runners.name: Nyman
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with 7f Newcastle victory and he's back in very good form of late, third of 14 in 1m handicap at Redcar a week ago; a likely player eased 1lb.
runners.comment: Back in very good form of late, third of 14 at Redcar a week ago; likely player eased 1lb

runners.name: Starliner
runners.spotlight: Ended a losing sequence at Ayr (1m) in May and largely in good nick since, sixth of ten in 1m handicap at Hamilton two weeks ago; no forlorn hope eased 1lb.
runners.comment: Solid sixth of ten in 1m handicap at Hamilton two weeks ago; no forlorn hope eased 1lb
runners.owner: David Orr & Miss L A Perratt

runners.name: Documenting
runners.spotlight: Winless since 2024 but this veteran arrives in decent nick, runner-up at Newbury (7f) in June before a creditable tenth of 17 in 7f Ascot handicap last month; not totally dismissed.
runners.comment: Winless since 2024 but this veteran arrives in decent nick; no forlorn hope
runners.owner: Kevin Frost Racing Club & Mike Humphries

runners.name: Bella Bisbee
runners.spotlight: Doubled her tally over C&D in June and was right back on song when close second at Lingfield (7f, good to firm) last month but has a point to prove after weakening quickly on AW a fortnight ago.
runners.comment: Doubled tally over C&D in June; needs to rebound from poor AW run two starts ago

runners.name: Rock Opera
runners.spotlight: Resumed winning ways at Pontefract (6f) in June but below par in big-field 6f handicaps at York on his last two runs; this course scorer needs to bounce back on a rare run over 7f.
runners.comment: Resumed winning ways at Pontefract (6f) in June but below par at York on his last two runs

runners.name: Thapa Vc
runners.spotlight: Ended a losing run over C&D in July and quickly followed up with comfortable success in 7f Yarmouth handicap 18 days ago; up another 7lb now but very much one to consider in his hat-trick bid.
runners.comment: Ended losing run over C&D and quickly followed up at Yarmouth; very much one to consider

runners.name: Criminal Shore
runners.spotlight: Scored at Newcastle (1m) in June but he has failed to reproduce it in three turf outings since and came in last of 11 at Haydock (7f) eight days ago; others are much preferred.
runners.comment: Scored at Newcastle in June but he has failed to reproduce it in three turf outings since

runners.name: The Childe Of Hale
runners.spotlight: Gained a first win over C&D last July but well below that level in five subsequent starts, although he suffered a poor run when tenth of 12 in 1m Ripon handicap in June; cheekpieces go on after a break.
runners.comment: Gained a first win over C&D last July but well below that level in five subsequent runs
runners.owner: The Good Racing Company Ltd & Partner

runners.name: Age Of Baroque
runners.spotlight: A fair 7f scorer for Marco Botti last June; back on song for his current stable when second of 11 over C&D in June; not out of things despite a 2lb weights rise.
runners.comment: Back on song with second over C&D in June; not out of things despite a 2lb weights rise

runners.name: Imperial Guard
runners.spotlight: Back in fine form this summer since stepped up to 7f and he narrowly completed a hat-trick under a 7lb penalty at Ayr 19 days ago; this strong traveller merits serious consideration despite a further 3lb rise.
runners.comment: Completed quick hat-trick at Ayr latest; merits serious consideration despite 3lb rise

runners.name: War Howl
runners.spotlight: A two-time scorer (including over C&D) for Michael Appleby last summer; well below par for his present handler this season, however, and he failed to beat a rival in 1m Pontefract handicap last time.
runners.comment: C&D winner last summer; well below par for his present handler this season however
runners.owner: Future Champions Racing Syn & Ben Haslam

runners.name: Bright
runners.spotlight: Course winner who comes here on the back of a respectable seventh of 12 in 6f Southwell handicap 19 days ago; possibilities from a falling mark.
runners.comment: Course winner; comes here on back of respectable seventh of 12 at Southwell; possibilities

races.race_name: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap

runners.name: Zubaru
runners.spotlight: Has progressed really well this season and notched a third success over 6f here in June; posted a good fifth of ten in 6f handicap at Newmarket (form franked) last month so must enter calculations.
runners.comment: Good fifth at Newmarket last month; must enter calculations in bid for fourth win of 2026

runners.name: Ancient State
runners.spotlight: Progressive sort who notched a third victory of 2026 at Lingfield (5f) in June; went very freely from widest draw and did well in circumstances when fifth of 13 in 6f Windsor handicap last time; a player eased 1lb.
runners.comment: Very free from wide draw and good fifth at Windsor last time; player eased 1lb

runners.name: Papa Cocktail
runners.spotlight: Scored at Wolverhampton (6f) in January and largely in good nick since, challenging wide when sixth of ten in another 6f handicap there last time; can make his presence felt.
runners.comment: Scored at Wolverhampton in January and largely in good nick since; can make presence felt

runners.name: Golden Long
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 6yo who is much improved for his new yard this summer, gaining a second success in his last three runs in 6f handicap at Newmarket last month; up 4lb but that form has been well advertised since so he merits serious consideration.
runners.comment: Second win for new yard at Newmarket latest; form franked so merits serious consideration

runners.name: Justmyluck
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at Newcastle (5f) in January but he has failed to build on it and came in last in 5f handicaps at Haydock and Hamilton (hooded) on his last two runs; others are much preferred.
runners.comment: Got off the mark at Newcastle (5f) in January but he has failed to build on it

runners.name: County Carlow
runners.spotlight: A fair 6f maiden winner at Sligo in May and signed off for Paddy Twomey with very good second in 7f Fairyhouse novice following month; since changed hands for 40,000gns and not out of things on his yard/handicap debut after a break.
runners.comment: Very good second at Fairyhouse latest; not out of things on yard/handicap debut
runners.owner: Future Champions Racing Syn & Mps Racing

runners.name: Flash Rascal
runners.spotlight: Signed off for Richard Newland and Jamie Insole with victory in 6f handicap at Haydock in April; up 6lb and needs to hit the ground running for his new handler after an absence.
runners.comment: Scored at Haydock in April; up 6lb and needs to hit the ground running for his new handler

runners.name: Lion's House
runners.spotlight: Not proving the easiest to catch right since going in at Newcastle (5f) in February but he comes here on the back of a good second of six in 5f Newmarket handicap a week ago; in the mix if on his A-game again.
runners.comment: Not proving the easiest to catch right since going in at Newcastle (5f) in February

runners.name: Squealer
runners.spotlight: A fairly useful 5f winner in 2025; yet to hit top form this season though, third of four in 5f Nottingham handicap last month; more is needed despite a tumbling mark.
runners.comment: A fairly useful 5f winner in 2025; yet to hit top form this season though

runners.name: Brummell
runners.spotlight: Won three times over 5f in 2025; got back on track in first-time cheekpieces with fourth of ten in 6f Chester handicap in June; no forlorn hope off a 2lb lower mark here with headgear retained.
runners.comment: Back on track in first-time cheekpieces with Chester fourth in June; no forlorn hope

races.race_name: Luxury Looks From The Avenue At Meadowhall Handicap

runners.name: Snaafy
runners.spotlight: Scored at Wolverhampton (8.5f) in December but he's not proving the easiest to catch right this season, only ninth of 18 at Galway (8.5f) 15 days ago.
runners.comment: Scored at Wolverhampton in December but not proving the easiest to catch right this season

runners.name: Celtic Chariot
runners.spotlight: Son of Ghaiyyath who is on the up since sent handicapping, scoring over C&D and at Yarmouth (1m) last month; up 4lb but another bold showing is on the cards in his hat-trick bid.
runners.comment: On the up since sent handicapping, scoring over C&D and at Yarmouth; bold showing on cards

runners.name: Berlinetta
runners.spotlight: Fair maiden for William Haggas; has made a bright start for her new handler and gained a breakthrough victory in 1m Windsor handicap 19 days ago; not taken lightly nudged up 2lb.
runners.comment: Bright start for new yard and scored at Windsor latest; not taken lightly nudged up 2lb

runners.name: Vega's Virtue
runners.spotlight: Notched a second success of 2026 at Ripon (1m) in July and followed it with a very good third of seven off an 8lb higher mark in another 1m handicap there 12 days ago; must enter calculations.
runners.comment: Very good third at Ripon 12 days ago; must enter calculations off same mark

runners.name: Lady Hornblower
runners.spotlight: A fair 7.5f winner as a 2yo; returned to form after wind surgery with third of seven in 7.5f handicap at Beverley 18 days ago; needs to back it up now.
runners.comment: Good third after wind op at Beverley 18 days ago; needs to back it up now

runners.name: Napolian
runners.spotlight: Gained a first success at Leicester (1m) in June but has failed to kick on since, just seventh of ten in 1m Ayr handicap five days ago; hood is reached for now.
runners.comment: Gained a first success at Leicester (1m) in June but has failed to kick on; hood goes on

runners.name: Taradif
runners.spotlight: Fair 1m maiden for Francis-Henri Graffard; off four months before a never-dangerous seventh of ten for new stable in 9.5f handicap at Wolverhampton in June; more is needed after another break.
runners.comment: Seventh at Wolverhampton in June for new yard; more is needed after another break

races.race_name: Raceday Ready With Meadowhall Handicap

runners.name: Rajendra
runners.spotlight: Best of his five efforts when fourth of 11 in 1m Southwell maiden (AW) in January with a first-time hood, which has been kept since; upped in trip again today but the heavy defeats in his two handicaps (last of three in latest) means that caution is advised.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats in his two handicaps (last of three in latest) means that caution is advised

runners.name: Lednikov
runners.spotlight: Often a front-runner and the last six of his seven wins were on Southwell AW, with the latest in March; Elle-May Croot knows him especially well and he's back 1lb below his last winning mark but the return to Southwell (from turf) for latest outing did not spark an upturn; best watched at present.
runners.comment: Often a front-runner and the last six of his seven wins were on Southwell AW, March latest

runners.name: Sound Gloria
runners.spotlight: Staying-on third over 1m2f on handicap debut and duly built on that when plugging on well to get on top close home at 10-11 in a seven-runner 1m4f race at Catterick (again good to firm) 18 days later; 5lb rise demands more from her but another step up in trip today may well provide it; big chance.
runners.comment: Got on top close home when 10-11 in a seven-runner race at Catterick (1m4f, good to firm)

runners.name: Is She Now
runners.spotlight: Winner at Ayr (1m5f) and Musselburgh (1m4f) in June and has run well on all three starts since, runner-up over 1m3f and 2m on last two occasions; latest was quite a rare run in cheekpieces; should be bang there.
runners.comment: Winner twice in June and has run well on all three starts since; should be bang there

runners.name: Manbearpig
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden after six races, failing to kick on in handicaps this term; tried blinkers on latest start; now it's cheekpieces and a longer trip.
runners.comment: Modest maiden after six races, failing to kick on in handicaps; different headgear

runners.name: Alcanzor
runners.spotlight: Fifth of ten in handicap at Southwell (1m3f, AW) on latest start was his closest finish but he still has major work to do; wore cheekpieces that day and connections now turn to blinkers and an extra 3f.
runners.comment: Closest finish last time (1m3f, AW) but he still has major work to do; different headgear

runners.name: Character Testing
runners.spotlight: Visored first time (occasionally tried other headgear) when a hampered, running-on second of seven under 7lb claimer over 1m4f at Beverley 18 days ago and that was the best Flat result since his win in January 2024; unraced beyond that latest 1m4f on Flat (second over a sharp 2m1f as hurdler); place chance but, with a 1-30 strike-rate, probably not the percentage call.
runners.comment: Place chance but, with a 1-30 strike-rate, probably not the percentage call

races.race_name: Newly Weds Sara & Nigel Irish EBF Fillies Maiden

runners.name: Phlox
runners.spotlight: Camelot filly is related to Group winnners, and is out of one too; fair fifth over 1m5f at Leopardstown; starting to retreat when hit the rail and became unbalanced at Killarney, which exaggerated the margin of defeat; yard was quiet at the time too, so that run is best ignored.
runners.comment: Fair fifth over 1m5f at Leopardstown; hit the rail and became unbalanced at Killarney
runners.owner: Barnane Stud & Hollywood Stud Ireland Limited

runners.name: Essential Comedy
runners.spotlight: Promising debut over 1m5f at Leopardstown when finished upsides Phlox; didn't finish off as well when beaten further at Fairyhouse.
runners.comment: Promising debut over 1m5f at Leopardstown when finished upsides Phlox; not as good since

runners.name: Sea Of The Celts
runners.spotlight: Sea The Stars filly cost 525,000gns as a yearling; dam Group-placed 1m4f-1m6f winner, half-sister to winners Prince Of Arran (1m4f Australian Group 3/Melbourne Cup runner-up) and Souter (useful 1m/8.5f); held an Irish Oaks entry; missed intended debut at Killarney last month.
runners.comment: Sea The Stars filly cost 525,000gns as a yearling; half-sister to classy Prince Of Arran

runners.name: U S Navy Spearhead
runners.spotlight: Yard won 1m4f maiden a couple of years ago with this one's half-sister Trapalanda, and half-brother Ney is useful dual-purpose performer who has won six races; dam won over 1m.
runners.comment: Yard won 1m4f maiden a couple of years ago with this one's half-sister Trapalanda

runners.name: Mawhibah
runners.spotlight: Decent debut on rain-softened ground at Leopardstown and then beaten just over 2l by shorter-priced stablemate over this trip at Limerick, sticking to her task; second and fifth both won at Galway.
runners.comment: Beaten just over 2l by shorter-priced stablemate over this trip at Limerick; strong form
runners.owner: Mohammed Bin Hamad Khalifa Al Attiyah

runners.name: Express Choise
runners.spotlight: Plugged away on last month's debut over 1m4f at Limerick, but has 10l to find with fourth-placed Mawhibah.
runners.comment: Plugged away on debut over 1m4f at Limerick, but 10l to find with fourth-placed Mawhibah
runners.owner: Carl Anthony Howell & Mrs Pauline Condon

races.race_name: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden

runners.name: Glittering Gem
runners.spotlight: Frankel filly from a fine Moyglare family; just beaten by a fellow 70-rated rival in an optional claimer at Sligo last week; on pedigree, this longer trip shouldn't be a problem; looking at her action the last day, probably doesn't want it too quick.
runners.comment: Just beaten by a fellow 70-rated rival in an optional claimer at Sligo; should stay 1m4f

runners.name: Solness
runners.spotlight: Top-class chaser weakend out of contention in the Galway Hurdle; ran in a Curragh 1m4f maiden (without usual cheekpieces) as a prep for that, and a perfectly respectable effort saw him run to a mark of somewhere in the mid-70s, using the runner-up as a guide.
runners.comment: Top-class chaser weakend out of it in Galway Hurdle; ran well at the Curragh previously

runners.name: Kaleo Ametsa
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in bumpers and rated 103 over hurdles; seemed to run well when plugging away to be fifth in 1m7f amateur riders' maiden at Leopardstown, but they went steady and she's likely flattered by the bare formline.
runners.comment: Semed to run well in 1m7f amateur riders' maiden at Leopardstown, but probably flattered

runners.name: Shirzan
runners.spotlight: Third in a Leopardstown bumper in March before winning on hurdling debut at Limerick later that month; both of those runs on soft; well held in Cork novice hurdle on good ground when last seen in May; this is probably a prep for Listowel.
runners.comment: Third in a bumper before winning on hurdling debut at Limerick; both of those runs on soft

runners.name: Onlytheriverknows
runners.spotlight: Sioux Nation newcomer is half-brother to German winners Fataliste (1m1f) and Fascianata (1m7f); dam German 8.5f winner, out of German 7f Listed winner.
runners.comment: Sioux Nation newcomer is half-brother to pair of German winners; dam German 8.5f winner

runners.name: Metallic
runners.spotlight: Wootton Bassett gelding; half-brother to smart performer Mohawk (7f-1m1f inc 2yo Group 2; RPR 114); dam 6f-1m winner (inc AW 2yo/Group 3;), out of 7f Listed winning half-sister to 7f-1m1f Group 1 winner Bigstone; no star at home if he's coming here for his debut, but the market will tell us more.
runners.comment: Wootton Bassett gelding out of Group 3 winner; half-brother to Group 2 winner Mohawk

runners.name: Davy Crockett
runners.spotlight: By Camelot out of top-class racemare Annie Power; won his first three races last summer, a bumper and two hurdles, but the wheels have come off since; wasn't up to Graded level or smart handicaps in the spring, albeit easy ground was against him several times, and tipped up on chasing debut in May; King will fill him with confidence and has the ability to go close.
runners.comment: Won his first three races last summer, but the wheels have come off since; first Flat run
runners.owner: John P McManus & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Nothingbutadream
runners.spotlight: Dire form in two runs and no chance here.
runners.comment: Dire form in two runs and no chance here

runners.name: Aiteall
runners.spotlight: Well-bred Wootton Bassett gelding had run in a barrier trial before making his debut last week at Leopardstown; 16s, never a factor over 1m1f; dam is a sister to Irish 1,000 Guineas third So Wonderful, but yet to produce a winner.
runners.comment: Well-bred Wootton Bassett gelding; 16s, never a factor over 1m1f at Leopardstown

runners.name: Keep It Together
runners.spotlight: Poor form under both codes; no chance here.
runners.comment: Poor form under both codes; no chance here

races.race_name: Morris DIY Rated Race

runners.name: Maxminelli
runners.spotlight: Maiden with solid placed form on last three starts; got this trip okay on handicap debut at Limerick, where he was readily outpaced by a Joseph O'Brien-trained winner; that form took a few hits at Galway, but good chance of being in the three again here.
runners.comment: Got this trip okay at Limerick when readily outpaced by a Joseph O'Brien-trained winner

runners.name: Tanzanite Diamond
runners.spotlight: Fair maiden form and ran respectably on handicap debut in higher-grade contest at the Curragh; outpaced before the straight over 1m1f at Leopardstown last week and going back up in trip should help.
runners.comment: Outpaced over 1m1f at Leopardstown last week and going back up in trip should help

runners.name: A Pretty Penny
runners.spotlight: Ballinrobe 9.5f winner was no match for Rodeo Blues back there, but is 15lb better off here; well held when second to older rival over C&D last month; usually leads.
runners.comment: No match for Rodeo Blues at Ballinrobe, now 15lb better off; second to older foe over C&D

runners.name: Sunrush
runners.spotlight: Bolger-bred Teofilo gelding; good fourth in a hot Curragh maiden last year; okay comeback over 1m at Leopardstown, and soft ground probably the reason for a poor display on handicap debut at same track; gelded since and steps up in trip here.
runners.comment: Soft ground probably the reason for a poor display on handicap debut; gelded since

runners.name: Mare Crisium
runners.spotlight: Front-running fourth over 1m1f at Ballinrobe, but that's not strong from, and was beaten 10l when filling same position over 1m5f at Sligo last week.
runners.comment: Beaten 10l in fourth when stepped up to 1m5f at Sligo last week

runners.name: Rodeo Blues
runners.spotlight: Went up sharply in the ratings for two wins over shorter, but nothing wrong with her run against older rivals over this trip at Galway; valuable 7lb off and definitely capable of winning more races; went badly left off the home bend at Ballinrobe, but ran straighter at Galway.
runners.comment: Nothing wrong with her run against older rivals over 1m4f at Galway; valuable 7lb off
runners.owner: Annus Mirabilis Synd'/Sean O'Driscoll/Middle Cow Unlimited

runners.name: Love Orchid
runners.spotlight: Saxon Warrior filly has been disappointing since entering handicaps; fair fourth in a Killarney claimer last month; led before backpedalling in the straight at Galway; hasn't raced beyond an extended 1m; dam's half-brother won Group 3 over 1m5f.
runners.comment: Led before backpedalling in the straight at Galway; hasn't raced beyond an extended 1m

runners.name: Tickle The Cat
runners.spotlight: Not a bad run in a 1m Naas maiden when last seen in June, beaten 14l and still looked very green; sister to 1m6f winner and smart jumper Teddy Blue; could be a different proposition in middle-distance handicaps, so not one to rule out.
runners.comment: Sister to 1m6f winner and smart jumper Teddy Blue; could make an impact in handicaps

races.race_name: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap

runners.name: Stepdance
runners.spotlight: Completed a summer hat-trick in this last year, which was her second C&D win; mid-field run at Leopardstown, after a break, rendered her eligible for repeat bid.
runners.comment: Completed a summer hat-trick in this last year, which was her second C&D win

runners.name: Miss Australie
runners.spotlight: Off the mark over this trip at Roscommon in May and came home well in 10.5f claimer at Sligo last week; 1lb drop gets her back into this grade.
runners.comment: Finished well in 10.5f claimer at Sligo last week; 1lb drop gets her back into this grade

runners.name: Tassarolo
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose 5yo won at Killarney last summer and his third of 15 at that track last month was the closest he's come this term.
runners.comment: Third of 15 at Killarney last month was the closest he's come this term

runners.name: Preparations
runners.spotlight: Winner over this trip at three; won a hurdle and some good placed efforts on the Flat last year; comes here a fresh horse and ran respectably at Ballinrobe last month where met some interference.
runners.comment: Comes here a fresh horse; ran respectably at Ballinrobe last month where met interference

runners.name: Spinning Web
runners.spotlight: AW winner at three and dual winner over fences last year; couple of first-fence falls in March and quiet since; okay run at Navan in June; second to Stepdance over C&D last July, off this mark, and now meets her on a whopping 25lb better terms; only second time to wear blinkers.
runners.comment: Okay run at Navan latest; his second to Stepdance, over C&D last July, brings him into it

runners.name: Limestone Red
runners.spotlight: Recorded his second 10.5f AW win in January and is rated 15lb higher on that surface; fine effort over just shy of this trip at Killarney last month, beaten half a length by in-form mare with Tassarolo a length behind him in third.
runners.comment: Fine effort over just shy of this trip at Killarney last month, beaten half a length

runners.name: Go Flo Jo
runners.spotlight: Not shamed in four handicaps last year, but yet to place; has come down 10lb from initial mark; been off nearly nine months.
runners.comment: Not shamed in four handicaps, but yet to place; has come down 10lb from initial mark

runners.name: Nathema
runners.spotlight: Well-bred filly (grand-daughter of Oaks/Irish Oaks winner Sariska) is sole 3yo in here; yet to be competitive, including when 20-1 for handicap debut at Cork, and slowly away last twice; headgear.
runners.comment: Yet to be competitive, including when 20-1 for handicap debut at Cork; headgear

runners.name: Mullacurry Maid
runners.spotlight: Respectable run in a classy Leopardstown maiden on her return, but beaten a long way on handicap debut over 1m1f at same track.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way on handicap debut over 1m1f at Leopardstown

runners.name: Duleek Street
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced since winning a Cartmel hurdle in 2023 and coming back from a year off; has twice been second over 1m4f and stable is going better, but he's obviously opposable.
runners.comment: Twice second over 1m4f and stable is going better, but coming back from a year off

races.race_name: Perennial Freight Handicap

runners.name: Marmeladova
runners.spotlight: Added to her Ballinrobe maiden win over an extended 1m1f trip when landing a 1m2f Leopardstown handicap by a neck off 75 last month; her run at the Curragh last time was too bad to be true when sweating and beaten 21l in last place; finished 2.75l behind Daboya in their C&D meeting in July; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Questions to answer after dismal run latest; 2.75l behind Daboya in their last C&D meeting

runners.name: Merlin The Wizard
