runners.spotlight: Three wins in Britain in 2023 at up to 1m; regressive in 2024 and 2025 seasons; took advantage of a drop in grade and forceful tactics when winning a claimer over this trip at Limerick and backed that up in a Ballinrobe handicap off 72 (1m2f, yielding); not too bad in two runs at the Galway festival; good claimer takes off weight and this track may suit.
runners.comment: Back-to-back winner in June, the latest off 72; good claimer up and track may suit

runners.name: Churchwarden
runners.spotlight: Bounced back to form when gaining a first Flat win on his third run for this yard over C&D last month in first-time blinkers, successful by 10l; hefty 12lb hike for that but interesting if headgear continues to work; just second over hurdles here on Thursday.
runners.comment: Back to form when winning easily over C&D last month in first-time cheekpieces; up 12lb

runners.name: Rakki
runners.spotlight: Fairly useful hurdler last season, winning a Roscommon maiden; well held in handicaps, however; standout Flat run for Alan King when touched off in 1m6f Sandown handicap two years ago off 3lb higher; didn't appear to stay the extended 2m trip at Galway on his return to this discipline last time; opposable.
runners.comment: Fairly useful hurdler didn't appear to stay extended 2m trip back on Flat latest

runners.name: Berto Ramirez
runners.spotlight: Yet to win after eight Flat starts but took a Down Royal maiden hurdle in May; solid effort over 1m4f at Galway last month (yielding to soft); two-day break possibly to blame when disappointed over hurdles back there last time; others appeal more.
runners.comment: 0-8 on Flat but good Galway festival run before short turnaround when poor over hurdles
runners.owner: D O'Mahony & D McHugh & D J Kelly & G Butler

runners.name: Daboya
runners.spotlight: Up a total of 13lb for back-to-back wins at Ballinrobe (1m5f, yielding) and over C&D (good) when 2.75l ahead of Marmeladova (that rival 3lb better off now); finished last at Gowran last time (1m5f, good to firm), which is not fully explained by her new rating; can do better back here.
runners.comment: Up 13lb total for back-to-back wins including C&D; last at Gowran latest; can do better

runners.name: Expound
runners.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner won off 2lb higher at Ballinrobe last year (1m2f, good) and returned to the same race in May when an okay fourth of nine; something seemingly went wrong when pulled up over hurdles at Clonmel in May; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Three-time Flat winner was an okay fourth in May; 2lb below his last winning mark now

races.race_name: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap

runners.name: Clear Quartz
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner is 6lb above his last winning mark at Roscommon in September (1m4f, soft); good second on seasonal return at Leopardstown in June (1m1f, soft) but below his best at the Curragh and Galway (2m1f, yielding) since then; slowly away and stumbled in that latest outing, which was a first try at a 2m+ trip; best form on softer.
runners.comment: Six-time winner has been below his best in latest two runs; best form on soft

runners.name: Way Down South
runners.spotlight: Modest jumper (rated 99) is 0-3 on Flat and has been well beaten in all those outings; makes his Flat handicap bow, now upped to 2m, from a reasonable initial mark and good claimer aboard.
runners.comment: Modest jumper makes Flat handicap bow from reasonable mark and good claimer aboard

runners.name: Delta
runners.spotlight: Fairyhouse maiden winner last season (1m4f, good to yielding); made a cracking return to action in May when fourth in a big-field handicap at the Curragh (1m6f, good); has disappointed as favourite in two runs since at the Curragh (2m1f, good to firm) and at Leopardstown in a five-runner conditions event (1m7f, good, 4-6); capable of more.
runners.comment: Disappointed as favourite in two most recent runs; capable of more

runners.name: Filey Bay
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdles winner has scored twice on the Flat, including over C&D; latest win was in the valuable amateur riders' handicap at the Galway festival last year (2m1f, yielding) off 5lb lower; disappointed on seasonal return in that race last time; must take a big step forward from that first run, but he has tended to do so in past seasons.
runners.comment: Poor return at Galway in race he won last season but tends to improve for first run back

runners.name: Plontier
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle at Sligo for Willie Mullins in August 2024; failed to win on the Flat for that stable (no Flat win since 2022); ran respectably over 1m4f on stable debut here in a claimer; not disgraced in a valuable Galway Flat handicap last time (2m1f, yielding) when wearing this headgear for the first time; dropped 3lb for that.
runners.comment: Not bad efforts in two runs for new yard; retains headgear he sported at Galway

runners.name: Zoffman
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner in 2022 and added a maiden hurdle last year; just okay Flat handicap runs this season before tailed off effort over hurdles at Ballinrobe; beaten 22l at Fairyhouse last time; others preferred.
runners.comment: Running just okay in Flat handicaps before poor efforts in his latest two outings

runners.name: Miss Gitana
runners.spotlight: Bounced back to form with a close third under a positive ride over 1m7f at Leopardstown last month; form of that race is questionable and she's 4lb out of the weights, but C&D winner last summer and her rider's claim helps; trainer returned to the winners' enclosure at Galway earlier this month.
runners.comment: Back to form when third latest; C&D winner is 4lb out of weights but rider's claim helps

runners.name: Spasiba
runners.spotlight: Off since pulling up in a Grade 1 novice hurdle at Naas in January 2025; won a 1m2f Flat maiden at Roscommon in 2022 for Paddy Twomey and a Naas maiden hurdle in 2024; tough task given his absence.
runners.comment: Winner of a Flat maiden/maiden hurdle but off since January 2025, so tough task

races.race_name: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap

runners.name: Gallo Dell Cielo
runners.spotlight: Back-to-back winner on AW at 1m4f/2m earlier this year and didn't run badly back there when last seen in February (2m); 1-13 on turf and rated 21lb lower on this surface; second off 1lb higher at Tipperary in August last year, but poor at Down Royal next time when last seen on turf.
runners.comment: Rated 21lb lower on this surface following two AW wins earlier this year; 1-13 on turf

runners.name: Kings Gesture
runners.spotlight: Modest form so far; well beaten in opening two handicaps on AW and was tailed off at Ballinrobe last month on his first try on turf; new headgear goes on.
runners.comment: Modest form so far; tailed off last time

runners.name: Highway Sixty One
runners.spotlight: Now winless from 17 Flat starts but has posted some solid runs this season, including when chasing home an easy winner over 1m4f here on penultimate; hampered at Killarney last time when beaten 7l; tries this trip on the Flat for the first time in his career; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: 0-17 on Flat but solid runs this season including here; tries this trip for first time

runners.name: Synchronize
runners.spotlight: Maiden gelding by Frankel; has shown potential for a belated breakthrough in his three Flat runs this term, the latest when sixth over C&D (4-1 fav), where today's rider was banned for stopping riding late on (4.5l behind Lariat); others more appealing.
runners.comment: M'aien gelding by Frankel has run okay in three Flat runs this term, but others preferred

runners.name: Crypto Crash
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; 0-13 on the Flat and winless from seven over hurdles, including when falling at the sixth at Cork last time; two Flat runs this season do nothing to excite and 3lb wrong.
runners.comment: 0-13 on Flat and runs this term don't excite; 3lb wrong

runners.name: Bynx
runners.spotlight: Versatile mare gained a first Flat win over C&D at the 22nd attempt last month (Lariat 1.25l behind); ran to her mark over fences at Wexford last time; returns to the scene of her victory 4lb higher and could go well.
runners.comment: Got a first Flat win at 22nd attempt over C&D last month off 4lb lower; could go well

runners.name: Stone Rulya
runners.spotlight: First reserve; poor in opening runs over hurdles this year and well beaten on the Flat in a 1m4f claimer here and a 1m7f handicap at Leopardstown, so others preferred; the visor is new as is this lower grade.
runners.comment: Reserve; poor over hurdles and on Flat this term so others preferred

runners.name: God Of Thunder
runners.spotlight: Was in better form last year when winning at Limerick over hurdles and on the Flat (1m5f, good, rated 73); largely struggled in both codes since, although ran to his mark at Killarney last month when sixth (1m4f, good); took second in a Sligo claiming hurdle last time when well treated; others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Largely struggled in both codes since winning off 15lb lower last summer at Limerick

runners.name: Vervain
runners.spotlight: Won a Cork 3yo handicap last summer off 1lb lower for Joe Murphy (1m4f, good); pushed wide off the bend when a keeping-on fourth here on seasonal return (1m4f, good), Highway Sixty One 4.5l ahead; close fourth at Killarney next time and raised 3lb for her head defeat at Gowran eight days ago (1m5f, good), shaping like this trip was worth a try; new cheekpieces on.
runners.comment: Won off 1lb lower at Cork last year; shaped well in last two runs; interesting up in trip

runners.name: Fine Print
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner at 1m6f/2m1f last year; 0-15 on the Flat on turf; moderate run at Down Royal over this trip when last seen on the Flat and poor over hurdles in his last two runs; others more likely.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner is 0-15 on turf; poor when last seen on Flat and last twice over hurdles

runners.name: Lariat
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner but nothing since 2022; yet to score from 28 runs over hurdles; ran well over C&D in July when runner-up off this mark; pulled up over hurdles next time; he's better in this sphere, but long losing run drastically reduces his appeal.
runners.comment: Dual Flat winner ran well here on his last Flat start; no wins since 2022 is concerning

runners.name: Fire Coral
runners.spotlight: Won back-to-back handicap hurdles at Downpatrick and Down Royal over 2m6f/3m last August; 0-9 on Flat and first go in this discipline since 2024; disappointed over hurdles at Wexford last time.
runners.comment: Back-to-back handicap hurdle winner last August; poor in that sphere last time

races.race_name: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Park Hall
runners.spotlight: Won her only point; hooded for both runs under rules, finishing first then second in bumpers at Newton Abbot; that form is nothing to get excited about but she's a Skelton newcomer to hurdling.
runners.comment: First and second in two bumpers, though form is nothing to get excited about

runners.name: Jentobello
runners.spotlight: Dual bumper winner who has been competitive in all four starts over hurdles, from 2m to 2m5f; cheekpieces worn on last two starts are removed; off since October but he's the standard setter.
runners.comment: Dual bumper winner; placed over hurdles; off since October but he's the standard setter

runners.name: Way Maker
runners.spotlight: The winner of two bumpers and a repeat of the RPR he posted when second in a Southwell maiden this June would see him bang there; he was a disappointing favourite here last time when behind Brosna Town.
runners.comment: Has form claims but a disappointing favourite here last time when behind Brosna Town

runners.name: Centurion's Sister
runners.spotlight: 0-3 in bumpers and 0-7 as a hurdler; however, she's consistent and has each-way claims on peak form; tries cheekpieces.
runners.comment: She's consistent and has each-way claims on peak form; tries cheekpieces

runners.name: Eagle One
runners.spotlight: High mileage on the Flat (3-37) and has always plied his trade at a modest level; limited appeal on this belated switch to hurdling.
runners.comment: High mileage on the Flat (3-37) and has always plied his trade at a modest level

runners.name: Ifyouhaveaplan
runners.spotlight: 0-4 in points and hasn't been that threatening in two bumpers; others preferred.
runners.comment: 0-4 in points and hasn't been that threatening in two bumpers; others preferred

runners.name: Brosna Town
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner for Dermot Weld; ran twice at the big recent meeting at Galway, predictably struggling in a Listed hurdle but then running okay over 1m4f; 0-5 as a jumper but was runner-up over C&D last month; chance.
runners.comment: Fair Flat performer; 0-5 as a jumper but was runner-up over C&D last month

runners.name: Arcimboldo
runners.spotlight: Poor maiden on the Flat and 150-1 when pulled up here two weeks ago.
runners.comment: Poor maiden on the Flat and 150-1 when pulled up here two weeks ago

runners.name: Just Keeps Rolling
runners.spotlight: 1-10 in Irish points and pulled up in all his races over hurdles; first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: 1-10 in Irish points and pulled up in all his races over hurdles; first-time cheekpieces

runners.name: Credit Union
runners.spotlight: No obvious sign of ability in three bumpers at Newcastle.
runners.comment: No obvious sign of ability in three bumpers at Newcastle

races.race_name: Bet Smarter With Oddschecker+ Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Loriko
runners.spotlight: Won two uncompetitive events this spring (2m4f/2m) and then finished close second to main market rival over about 2m6f here four weeks ago; rated 5lb above Eternal Angel on BHA ratings but that mark may flatter him.
runners.comment: Rated 5lb above Eternal Angel on BHA ratings but that mark may flatter him
runners.owner: Cherry Knoll Farm, M Ward & D Skelton

runners.name: Eternal Angel
runners.spotlight: Had four starts for Tom Lacey, winning a pair of 2m hurdle races and perhaps better again when a front-running third in a handicap at Cartmel (second run in cheekpieces); obvious claims with his main rival also doubly penalised.
runners.comment: His front-running third back in a handicap at Cartmel was perhaps another step forward

runners.name: Destination Unkown
runners.spotlight: On his Flat and jumps form he looks outclassed; the hood is new.
runners.comment: On his Flat and jumps form he looks outclassed; the hood is new

races.race_name: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.name: Ghasham
runners.spotlight: Now in his fourth stable, for which he won a 2m handicap chase at Hexham in June; beaten 8l next time at Cartmel and he has form there; mark just okay but couldn't rule out as this isn't a strong race.
runners.comment: Looks on the right sort of mark but couldn't rule out in current vein of form

runners.name: Clean Getaway
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner at Sedgefield but he's a dual C&D winner and ran well enough last time at Cartmel to command respect.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner and ran well enough last time at Cartmel to command respect

runners.name: Belle Le Grand
runners.spotlight: Record of 3-12 over hurdles, the last win off this mark; had a wind operation prior to finishing tailed off on chase debut at Uttoxeter, where she was a weak 14-1 chance in a race won by a stronger-fancied stablemate; needs to better that performance.
runners.comment: On last winning hurdle mark but didn't offer all that much on recent chase debut

runners.name: Miss Denver
runners.spotlight: Hasn't lived up to her excellent jumping pedigree and she's now 0-9 after finishing a well-held second at Newton Abbot; can jump to the right so this track should suit better, but she's not overly convincing.
runners.comment: She's now 0-9 after finishing a well-held second at Newton Abbot

runners.name: Dog Fox
runners.spotlight: Just one completion in three runs over fences and beaten 9l on that occasion; fairly well held in his last two races over hurdles as well; he's on a fair mark if everything did come together.
runners.comment: Just one completion in three runs over fences and beaten 9l on that occasion
runners.owner: The North West National Hunt Racing Club

runners.name: Gower Prince
runners.spotlight: First start for this stable when runner-up over C&D and had the hood back on then; no match for the winner at Newton Abbot but that was behind a Skelton hotpot; respected.
runners.comment: Second here before chasing home a Skelton favourite at Newton Abbot; respected

runners.name: My Friend Sean
runners.spotlight: Better hurdler than chaser, with him 5-14 in the one discipline and yet 0-7 over fences; his turn should come as it was a fair run last time at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good; beaten 3l off this mark); all his winning form is about this trip.
runners.comment: Better hurdler than chaser but second last time out and his turn should come

runners.name: Genbu
runners.spotlight: Record of 2-18 over hurdles and latest fourth at Uttoxeter wasn't too far off his best form; however, he's Flat bred so what he'll make of fences remains to be seen.
runners.comment: Capable hurdler but he's Flat bred so what he'll make of fences remains to be seen

races.race_name: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Ballintubber Boy
runners.spotlight: Below his best form this season but ran better at Perth (3m, good) when only 3l off the winner; unlikely to be far away.
runners.comment: Below his best form this season but ran better at Perth (3m) when only 3l off the winner

runners.name: Belvedere Blast
runners.spotlight: He was 3lb higher when winning this 12 months ago and didn't arrive here that day in great form; did finish third at Uttoxeter two runs back so could go well, despite a modest last run when the visor was back on (in which he's effective but now removed).
runners.comment: Modest last run but placed the time before; won this last year off 3lb higher

runners.name: Kiwi de Cotte
runners.spotlight: Dual point winner; came readily clear in a C&D maiden here in June but he disappointed under a penalty at Worcester when easy to back; cheekpieces added for handicap debut but others have greater substance to their claims.
runners.comment: Cheekpieces added for handicap debut but others have greater substance to their claims

runners.name: Lowlands
runners.spotlight: Made all in a 2m4f maiden and followed that with a second in handicap company over 2m6f; finishing effort was a bit underwhelming at Perth when 5l behind Ballintubber Boy over 3m; that run leaves her with something to prove stamina-wise.
runners.comment: Progressing but didn't appear see out the 3m last time at Perth, so stamina worries

runners.name: Ernest Gray
runners.spotlight: 1lb higher than for the 3m win at Aintree last October (good); hasn't approached that form in his only three races since but this is a drop in grade; should go well.
runners.comment: 1lb higher than for the 3m win at Aintree last October and this is a drop in grade

runners.name: Parikarma
runners.spotlight: Six wins divided between Flat and hurdling; has some respectable races during her losing streak but doesn't look on that good a mark.
runners.comment: Respectable runs during her losing streak but doesn't look on that good a mark

races.race_name: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap Chase

runners.name: Huckleberry Sting
runners.spotlight: Strong traveller who made it 2-4 over fences with a 3m success here last month but he finished weakly when second at Worcester (2m7f); this drop in trip won't hurt; 8lb higher than for that last win but the ability is there.
runners.comment: 2-5 over fences; 8lb higher than for last win but ability is there to go in again

runners.name: The Clonmel Kid
runners.spotlight: 2m4f winner at Newcastle in April and his following thirds were respectable, at about 3m; however, last two runs (2m4f) not so encouraging and has a lot of weight.
runners.comment: A winner in April; last two runs not so encouraging and has a lot of weight

runners.name: Uncle Al
runners.spotlight: Beat three rivals in a handicap chase at Huntingdon (2m7f, good to firm) in May; however, modest last run and his good days are few and far between.
runners.comment: Modest last run and his good days are few and far between

runners.name: Ribeye
runners.spotlight: Dual course winner but was behind Huckleberry Sting last time and he wants further ideally.
runners.comment: Dual course winner but was behind Huckleberry Sting last time and he wants further ideally

runners.name: A Dublin Job
runners.spotlight: Did well over fences for Harry Derham but nothing to show for four runs since leaving that trainer, latterly tried in a visor.
runners.comment: Has regressed since leaving Dan Skelton; no better for the visor last time

runners.name: Fast Deal
runners.spotlight: Sole win in 68 career starts did at least come over fences but he's not in much form and 10lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: 1-68 overall; he's not in much form and 10lb out of the weights

races.race_name: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: No More Bolero
runners.spotlight: Has won his last two (at about 2m), beating a subsequent winner at Worcester and then nicely on top in the finish here four weeks ago; that was in a small field but they went a good clip and this far will suit; up 4lb for last time.
runners.comment: Has won his last two (at about 2m) and this longer trip will suit

runners.name: Quick Of The Night
runners.spotlight: Best recent run was the 9l third at Worcester (2m, good) in a race she'd won twice before; ran no race back there last time and others appeal more.
runners.comment: Best recent run was the 9l third at Worcester; ran no race there last time

runners.name: Ballynoe Boy
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden who hasn't really improved for going into handicaps (2m3f-2m6f; 0-4) and was never remotely threatening last time at Cartmel; mark continues to fall and he's in good hands, so all hope not yet lost.
runners.comment: Nine-race maiden; mark continues to fall and he's in good hands, so all hope not yet lost

runners.name: Fine Point
runners.spotlight: The booking of Patrick Mullins was a likely factor in him going off 6-4f last time at Hexham where he raced freely and didn't last home over 2m4f; had made steady progress for this yard and, back over shorter with Joshua Thompson taking off 5lb, he should be involved.
runners.comment: Steady progress for current yard and appeared stretched by 2m4f the last time

runners.name: God Of Fire
runners.spotlight: Quite useful on the Flat and returned from a long absence to win a small-field maiden at Newton Abbot a month ago (2m2f, good to firm); difficult to gauge what he achieved there but brings potential into handicaps off what should be a good mark.
runners.comment: Returned from a long absence to win a small-field maiden at Newton Abbot a month ago

runners.name: Ashdown Forest
runners.spotlight: Left Jedd O'Keeffe for £21,000 in May and given wind surgery; first run since when justifying 5-6 favouritism in 11-runner handicap at Uttoxeter three weeks ago (2m, good); he did that narrowly but he was delivered late, so the 7lb rise could be very manageable.
runners.comment: Winning debut for this yard and delivered late, so probably good value for that

runners.name: Red Trail
runners.spotlight: Flat winner but a longstanding maiden over hurdles and arrives here in no form; 4lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: Flat winner but a longstanding maiden over hurdles and arrives here in no form

runners.name: Papillondelumiere
runners.spotlight: 40-1 when pulled up on handicap debut last month; 5lb out of the weights with more new headgear tried; very opposable.
runners.comment: 40-1 when pulled up on handicap debut last month; 5lb out of the weights

runners.name: Four Decades
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced mare but only five ran when fourth on handicap debut and was then tailed off at Uttoxeter; much to prove.
runners.comment: Only five ran when fourth on handicap debut and was then tailed off at Uttoxeter

runners.name: Lone Star
runners.spotlight: 2023 was her year but an infrequent winner these days and latest third here over 2m4f was remote; minor honours perhaps her best hope.
runners.comment: 2023 was her year but an infrequent winner these days and latest third was remote

races.race_name: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Pureis King
runners.spotlight: Two short-priced wins (0-50 classified, then a 0-55 handicap) before held off his revised mark at this level last time; that was another in-form effort, though, and there's no obvious reason he won't go well once more.
runners.comment: Held off this mark at this level latest but no obvious reason he won't go well once more

runners.name: Belle Amie
runners.spotlight: Two wins for her new yard before finishing last of four in better company seven weeks ago; maybe the good to firm ground did for her that night but she now has to prove this mark (5lb higher than when last successful) within range.
runners.comment: Maybe fast ground did for her last time but she now has to prove this mark within range

runners.name: Into Combat
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden who has run below market expectations in four starts this year and is evidently felt capable of better; again pulled hard when a beaten-favourite nine days ago (Tapeta) and much will hinge on how he responds to a first-time hood.
runners.comment: Evidently felt capable of better; much will hinge on how he responds to a first-time hood

runners.name: Louie's Folly
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden under both codes for four yards (trainer also saddles Tenadaay, who looks his best chance); hard to make a case for her back in the cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Regressive maiden under both codes for four yards; hard to make a case for her

runners.name: Maywedance
runners.spotlight: Dual Kempton winner who was below-par there on Wednesday evening; victories came for headgear coming off, then for going back on, so perhaps the removal will result in a better effort, but she's some way down the pecking order.
runners.comment: Dual Kempton winner who was below-par there on Wednesday evening; hard to fancy

runners.name: Beggarman
runners.spotlight: Four-time Polytrack winner who came back to form last time and is 2lb lower than when last successful (turf) last summer; often fluffs the start and is usually held up, so the bigger field won't hurt; one to consider.
runners.comment: Often fluffs the start and is usually held up, so bigger field won't hurt; one to consider
runners.owner: Mrs E Bickerton And A Streeter

runners.name: Belle Of Kt
runners.spotlight: Came away with an in-form rival when completing the hat-trick at Ffos Las on Wednesday (enjoyed the run of the race; now 2-2 for Millie Wonnacott); maybe won't go up by as much as the 5lb penalty when reassessed but a fair chance of going in again.
runners.comment: Maybe won't go up by as much as 5lb when reassessed but a fair chance of going in again

runners.name: Tenadaay
runners.spotlight: Four AW efforts better than his five turf runs (including three over hurdles), backing up his win early in the year with a second off this mark next time (both Tapeta); needs a bit more again back from five months off.
runners.comment: Four AW efforts better than his five turf runs; needs more again back from five months off

runners.name: Sea Of Charm
runners.spotlight: Back in form since returned to cheekpieces of late, latterly when beaten a nose by Belle Of Kt at Bath a fortnight ago; 6lb better off with her old rival and her last win came round here off 3lb higher, so there are reasons for optimism.
runners.comment: Back in form since returned to cheekpieces of late and there are reasons for optimism

races.race_name: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Silent Sadhu
runners.spotlight: Rare 2yo runner for his yard who wasn't beaten far at a huge price on his Newbury debut; upset in the stalls and pulled hard at Ascot three weeks ago, when cracking late and, while nurseries may be his time to shine, he does look to have ability.
runners.comment: Shown ability in two runs; nurseries may be his time to shine but worth a second look

runners.name: Honeymoon Bear
runners.spotlight: Fair turf debut behind a useful winner in June, for a yard far from noted for 2yos, and ran to a similar level when splitting two subsequent winners on Tapeta last time; wasn't best suited by the way that race panned out and is one to consider.
runners.comment: Not best suited by the way the race panned out last time (Tapeta) and is one to consider

runners.name: Paradise Angel
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to two winners, who both improved with time; trainer had a quiet year with juveniles thus far (1-23) and the market will show what's expected.
runners.comment: Trainer had a quiet year with juveniles thus far (1-23) and the market will guide

runners.name: Pen Lan Icon
runners.spotlight: Dam was happiest on soft/heavy ground and didn't win until she was a 4yo; trainer enjoying a fair season with 2yos but doesn't have a great record with them here down the years.
runners.comment: Trainer enjoying a fair season with 2yos but doesn't have a great record with them here

runners.name: Uncle Frank
runners.spotlight: 1,000gns yearling, £20,000 breeze-up 2yo who was inclined to pull hard out in daylight on his 5f Windsor debut in early summer; shaped alright in faring best of the newcomers that night but it wasn't much of a novice; has to settle from stall 10 up to 6f.
runners.comment: Shaped fairly when best of the newcomers on his Windsor debut; needs to settle better

runners.name: West To Rest
runners.spotlight: Found the seventh furlong stretching her on her debut here 11 days ago; entitled to have come on for that but it didn't look much of a maiden (winner exposed as ordinary).
runners.comment: Found the seventh furlong stretching her on her debut here recently; entitled to improve
runners.owner: Sarah Fern, Patricia James And Partner

runners.name: Premium Seat
runners.spotlight: Third foal of a 7f-1m4f winner; trainer (also runs Postremo) on the board for the season with 2yos in the week, but wouldn't be noted for newcomers these days.
runners.comment: Third foal of a 7f-1m4f winner; trainer wouldn't be noted for 2yo newcomers these days

runners.name: Postremo
runners.spotlight: Not an awful turf debut in the spring but was beaten a long way on Tapeta recently; low-grade nurseries may well be next on the agenda for a yard also responsible for Premium Seat.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way on Tapeta recently; low-grade nurseries may well be next

runners.name: He's Readytorumble
runners.spotlight: Related to several winners for his connections; pulled hard when well held on his 5f debut but bettered that last time, upped to this trip, despite hanging left (both turf); yard has a poor record with 2yos on the AW but he's open to more improvement.
runners.comment: Yard has a poor record with 2yos on the AW but he's open to more improvement

runners.name: Snow On The Beach
runners.spotlight: 30,000gns breeze-up 2yo who was easy to back when well held on her Bath (5.7f) debut for the Newland/Insole yard in the spring; new trainer always to be respected with new recruits and the market will help with this filly, who's tried in a hood.
runners.comment: New trainer always to be respected with new recruits; the market will help with this filly

runners.name: Launchpad
runners.spotlight: 16,000euros breeze-up 2yo who started 150-1 for his Windsor debut a month ago, when well held having had issues at the start;  will need a lot more from the outside stall for a trainer whose recent successes have all come with older horses.
runners.comment: 150-1 for his Windsor debut a month ago; will need a lot more from the outside stall

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing 415 Handicap

runners.name: Wyle Cop
runners.spotlight: Has rather mixed record this season but was back in good form when dominating from the front over C&D a week ago, and a recent 5lb rise is manageable if he's in the right mood again.
runners.comment: Has mixed record this season but dominated from the front over C&D a week ago

runners.name: Enter Sandman
runners.spotlight: Came good with two AW wins in April (5f/6f) but seemed quickly to go off the boil in June; further progress is not yet out of the question but he needs a two-month break to have done him good.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner in April; given break after two disappointing runs in June

runners.name: London Is Blue
runners.spotlight: Gained both wins in 5.2f Brighton nurseries last summer; close second of four at Yarmouth (5f, good to firm) last month, his second start this season, but didn't fire at Windsor a fortnight later; needs to respond well to first-time cheekpieces and prove himself on an AW surface.
runners.comment: Didn't fire on latest turf start; now sports cheekpieces; unproven on AW surfaces

runners.name: Stock Market
runners.spotlight: Placed three times over 5f/6f on turf in the spring but this is his first run for over two months and his record on Polytrack (safely held all three starts) is off-putting.
runners.comment: Placed three times on turf in the spring but his Polytrack record is off-putting

races.race_name: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap

runners.name: Logi Bear
runners.spotlight: Started nurseries on an unrealistic mark for Richard Hannon but has found his level again now, narrowly being denied off 1lb lower last time (best of the group that started out racing near side at Nottingham); this half-brother to a C&D winner is shortlisted.
runners.comment: Found his level again now; this half-brother to a C&D winner is shortlisted

runners.name: Far Too Fizzy
runners.spotlight: Often makes the running, as when winning over C&D off 4lb lower in January; yet to show anything on turf, so his latest Chester flop looks best written off, but there's other pace in here.
runners.comment: Yet to show anything on turf so latest flop looks best written off, but other pace in here

runners.name: Punchbowl Flyer
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who ran as well as could have been expected in a Tapeta claimer on tough terms last time; that effort confirmed him still in form but there's not much wiggle room off this mark.
runners.comment: Tough task last time; still in form but there's not much wiggle room off this mark

runners.name: Riley Rocks
runners.spotlight: Won twice on Tapeta early in the year and is having his first AW run since, off a mark 3lb lower than when last successful; a poor first effort since being gelded in a tongue-tie (off here) will need ignoring though.
runners.comment: Won twice on Tapeta early in the year; having his first AW run since; has to bounce back

runners.name: Perdy In Paris
runners.spotlight: Didn't look to see out 1m from the front at Goodwood last time but now the question is whether she'll have the toe for 6f round here; effectively 5lb lower today and it will be interesting to see how she goes in the market.
runners.comment: Question is will she have the toe for 6f round here; 5lb lower; market useful

runners.name: Kimbara
runners.spotlight: Keen-going maiden who's been running over further, latterly not seeing out a stiff 7f having again pulled hard; hung left more than once and the emphasis will be on speed this time from the outside stall.
runners.comment: Keen-going maiden who's been running over further; the emphasis will be on speed

runners.name: Hierarchy
runners.spotlight: Two wins (disqualified from one) and a close fourth to his name from four runs over C&D, his last success coming off 4lb higher in February; not as good or consistent now but unlucky not to go closer last time and the handicapper's given him every chance.
runners.comment: Not as good or consistent now but the handicapper's given him every chance

runners.name: Sir Alfie
runners.spotlight: Won twice in Ireland last season before closing out with two lesser efforts in Listed company; struggled for his current yard, coming a stone down the weights, and again didn't achieve much last time when fourth of five on turf here.
runners.comment: Struggled for current yard; didn't achieve much last time when fourth of five on turf here

races.race_name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap

runners.name: Monks Mead
runners.spotlight: Ended long losing spell when holding on by a nose in C&D classified in January and has made the frame here (1m, AW/1m1f, turf) on his last two appearances; likely contender.
runners.comment: Won over C&D in January and has made the frame here on last two outings; likely contender

runners.name: Sansanetti
runners.spotlight: Won four times (once over C&D) in 2025 and has gradually worked her way back to form this year; persistently denied a clear run when close fourth at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) last month and will be dangerous here if her luck improves.
runners.comment: Persistently denied clear run at Windsor last month; will be dangerous with better luck

runners.name: Sceptic
runners.spotlight: Not quite at best on last two turf starts but now only 2lb higher than when leading close home at Kempton (1m) in May, and this longer trip won't be a problem; a possible.
runners.comment: Not quite at best on last two turf starts but now only 2lb higher than for AW win in May

runners.name: Makes Me Wonder
runners.spotlight: In rear throughout when 50-1 for last month's belated seasonal debut at Wolverhampton (7f); still unexposed over this trip but has modest 1-15 strike-rate and needs to leave that recent effort a long way behind.
runners.comment: In rear throughout when 50-1 for last month's belated seasonal debut (7f)

runners.name: Pure Theory
runners.spotlight: 20-race maiden who was well beaten in two 1m2f Yarmouth handicaps last month; might be happier back on Polytrack but remains difficult to enthuse over.
runners.comment: 20-race maiden who was well beaten in two 1m2f Yarmouth handicaps last month

runners.name: Equion
runners.spotlight: Regressive 8yo who returned from a break with two low-key runs (8.3f/7f) in June/July; should be fine over today's longer trip and is too well handicapped to rule out but needs to up his game.
runners.comment: Regressive 8yo who returned from a break with two low-key runs (8.3f/7f) in June/July

runners.name: Wrist Art
runners.spotlight: Yet to add to his two Irish wins in 2023 but has performed well twice this month, finishing second in Windsor handicap (11.4f, good to firm) and fourth in classified race here (1m4f); this drop back in trip ought to suit; probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: On long losing run but has performed well twice this month; probably won't be far away

runners.name: Borderline Madness
runners.spotlight: Built upon satisfactory seasonal debut when winning at Southwell (1m) in April; absent since down-the-field turf run (albeit in better race than this) in May, though, and has stamina to prove over 1m2f.
runners.comment: 1m AW winner in April; absent since down-the-field run in May; has stamina to prove

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap

runners.name: Dark Rosa
runners.spotlight: Yet to win this season but kept on for third at Salisbury (1m, good) in June and only faded out of contention in closing stages at Wolverhampton (9.4f) last month, having raced wide throughout; on a tempting mark now; might be the answer.
runners.comment: Ran better than bare form suggests when sixth at Wolverhampton last time; on good mark now

runners.name: Fallacious Promise
runners.spotlight: Progressive 3yo who came from off the pace for emphatic success at Kempton (1m) on Monday and has now won two of his last three; also suited by this track; obvious contender under 6lb penalty.
runners.comment: Progressive 3yo who carries 6lb penalty for emphatic Kempton win on Monday

runners.name: Chapman's Peak
runners.spotlight: Won two Kempton nurseries (1m/7f) in October but has disappointed on all four starts this year; needs huge boost from the new cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Dual AW nursery winner in October but in poor form this year; cheekpieces now added

runners.name: Mbappe
runners.spotlight: Won off today's mark at Kempton (1m) in January but was soundly beaten after starting slowly in both turf races this summer; others look less risky.
runners.comment: Won off this mark in January but soundly beaten after starting slowly last two turf races

runners.name: Credit Forgedd It
runners.spotlight: A maiden after 11 starts but hasn't been with current stable long and comes here after making the frame in two 7f Epsom handicaps last month; looks ready or another crack at 1m and this return to Polytrack won't be a problem; could have a say.
runners.comment: Made the frame in two 7f Epsom handicaps last month; looks ready for another crack at 1m

runners.name: Shamacid
runners.spotlight: Returned from short break with two good 7f runs this spring; well handicapped if judged on those but his form has dipped since and he is yet fully to convince stamina-wise over 1m.
runners.comment: Well handicapped on 7f spring form but needs to better recent efforts and prove stamina

races.race_name: Christophe Clement Turf Stakes (Grade 1) (Inner Turf)

runners.name: Survie
runners.spotlight: Group 1 placed in Europe and took very well to US racing when impressive winner of Grade 2 Glens Falls Stakes over C&D 13 days ago; travelled well and showed fine turn of foot to beat Storm Miami by about 2l in distaff event that day; stiffer task this time but receives a handy 5lb sex allowance (it would be 3lb in Britain) and has strong claims if handling the short rest.
runners.comment: Group 1 placed in Europe; impressive Grade 2 winner on US debut (1m4f); sound chance

runners.name: Fort George
runners.spotlight: Sole Group victory from four attempts when winning a Group 3 at Meydan in January (1m2f) by a nose from Arabian Light; again travelled well long way in Grade 2 Bowling Green here (1m3f) last time but was outbattled, beaten a nose by Ole Crazy Bone; clearly capable of bold show but maybe better at 1m2f.
runners.comment: Won Group 3 at Meydan (1m2f) but outbattled by Ole Crazy Bone in Grade 2 here (1m3f)

runners.name: Program Trading
runners.spotlight: Formerly established as high-class runner at 1m to 9.5f, winner of three Grade 1s including 2023 Saratoga Derby here; first race as far as 1m3f when winning Grade 2 United Nations Stakes at Monmouth last time by nearly 3l from Uncle's Gold, running on strongly and plenty in hand; sole Grade/Group 1 winner in the field and could thrive at this trip (dam stayed 1m4f and is half-sister to 5l Park Hill winner over 14.5f).
runners.comment: Triple Grade 1 winner over shorter; won Grade 2 at 1m3f last time and is the one to beat.

runners.name: Ole Crazy Bone
runners.spotlight: Signed off 5yo campaign with easy 4l defeat of today's rival Tawny Port in Grade 2 at Kentucky Downs (1m4f) in September; improved again to win Grade 2 Bowling Green Stakes here (1m3f) by a nose from Fort George (who's now 2lb worse off), running on boldly to keep his smooth-travelling foe at bay; genuine sort with sound claims.
runners.comment: Dual Grade 2 winner from last three races, including 1m4f here; genuine sort, sound claims

runners.name: Ancient Egypt
runners.spotlight: Has progressed into smart performer as 3yo, winning Listed race at Newmarket in May before fine second over 1m4f in both the Group 2 King Edward VII at Royal Ascot (to Causeway, pair long way clear) and Group 1 Grand Prix de Paris at Longchamp (to Maltese Cross, caught near line); no easy task tactically from next to rail for David Egan, and gets only 4lb weight-for-age allowance (would be 10lb in Britain), but this improving colt has a lot of ability.
runners.comment: Listed winner, second in Group 2 and Group 1 since; highly talented and should run well

runners.name: Minaret Station
runners.spotlight: Takes time to warm up and very strong finisher for Grade 2 win as juvenile (8.5f, firm); had an eye-catching first go at 1m3f when half-length third to Ole Cray Bone and Fort George in Grade 2 Bowling Green here (1m3f), set plenty to do in a steadily run race but again finishing well; interesting.
runners.comment: Close third to Ole Cray Bone in Grade 2 here (1m3f), finishing well off; interesting

runners.name: Tawny Port
runners.spotlight: Smart performer on his day; career best when beaten a nose by Silawi in Grade 1 Canadian International at Woodbine (1m4f, firm) last October; returned to near best when winning Grade 2 Belmont Gold Cup at Saratoga (2m) in June by two and a half lengths from Navy Seal; difficult to catch right but might be capable of an upset.
runners.comment: Returned to form with comfortable Grade 2 win over 2m in June; inconsistent but capable

races.race_name: King's Plate Stakes (Conditions) (All Weather) (Tapeta)

runners.name: Imyourmedicineman
runners.owner: Oh Em Gee Stable & Ad Noir LLC

runners.name: Lara Antipova
runners.spotlight: Back for second campaign (23-weeks).Undefeated mare having her first run across the ditch. Latest run was a G1 win at Ellerslie. Michael Dee stays on board. Major player.

runners.name: Ghana's Akan
runners.spotlight: Last assignment this trip when handily placed and worked home soundly this course. Has a tricky draw. Shapes as a rough place prospect.
runners.owner: J A O'Neill, Mrs M F Anderson Et Al

runners.name: Shiki
runners.spotlight: Kicks off second campaign (21-weeks). Won the 2yo F Swp in her maiden campaign. Did a terrific job in her first campaign. Has a tricky draw and rising in weight. Place looks best.
runners.owner: Kurrinda Bloodstock, Mrs Y Smith Et Al

runners.name: Natural Fling
runners.spotlight: Kicks off second campaign (12-weeks). Smart debut at Caulfield 9 May & then went on to run 2nd at Gold Coast. Looks very promising. 2nd & 1st at latest jump-outs. Right in this.
runners.owner: Kildalton Park Racing, N B Smith Et Al

runners.name: Scintillation
runners.spotlight: Terrific winning the 2yo Hcp over 1100m at Randwick at $7.50. Drawn to effect. Soft proven, heavy unknown. Capable of figuring again.

runners.name: Rebel Tuesday
runners.spotlight: Had all before her at turn and went home tamely at Flemington for new stable. Untried in the wet. Hard to make a case.
runners.owner: Australian T'bred B'stock Pty Ltd, J E J Ciurlionis Et Al

runners.name: Stars Of Dom
runners.spotlight: Let-up (42-days). Just got there in the 2yo (Open) at Flemington in rain affected going last start. Soft tick, heavy query. Could repeat without surprise.
runners.owner: Lindsay Park Bloodstock, Needham Racing Et Al

runners.name: Satin Summer
runners.spotlight: Kept fresh since resuming. Reserved midfield and picked up intently in choppy conditions at Rosehill off spell. Since trialled at Warwick Farm 4 Aug. One for your exotics.

runners.name: Riverina Lulu
runners.spotlight: Made an immediate impact with a convincing win in soft going at Flemington. Can win again.

runners.name: Almost An Angel
runners.spotlight: Kicks off second campaign (20-weeks). Stakes-placed in first prep., Strikes a stronger field.
runners.owner: M Hymet, R Griffiths Et Al

runners.name: Lady Catalina
runners.spotlight: Let-up (63-days). Off the speed, picked up soundly and wasn't beaten far at Eagle Farm. Since trialled at Warwick Farm 4 Aug. Others with greater appeal.
runners.owner: Resolute Racing, C Massie Et Al

runners.name: Oh Yes She Did
runners.spotlight: Kept fresh. Gritty on pace victory 2yo F Mdn at Warwick Farm for new stable. Has an adverse draw. Prefer others.
runners.owner: Miss J Banks, Mrs C L Lovatt, Mrs S Cusack & M Hooton

runners.name: Santa Barbara
runners.spotlight: Excellent debut performance when just nabbed at Flemington at $21. Worth a look again.

runners.name: Portinari
runners.spotlight: 5 weeks since last run. Game effort this track in choppy conditions second-up. More a minor money chance here.

runners.name: Relinquishing
runners.spotlight: Kept finding the line without threatening at Flemington at second start. Meets a higher standard here.
runners.owner: S P Nichols, G D Pease Et Al

runners.name: Superbec
runners.spotlight: Outsprinted but determined in defeat down the Flemington straight 1 Aug. Tackling stronger line-up.
runners.owner: S P Morrissy, Mrs R J Morrissy Et Al

runners.name: Flying Fury
runners.spotlight: On pace and stuck on grittily for narrow 2yo Mdn win at Geelong. Took a step in the right direction latest but this isn't easy.
runners.owner: J O'Neill, Ms M Krepcik Et Al

runners.name: Private Eye
runners.spotlight: Let-up (63-days). Grand camapigner who loves a first-up run. Only got the wobbles late in the Stradbroke after leading them up last time. Must be considered.
runners.owner: Proven Thoroughbreds, P Yates Et Al

runners.name: Cosmic Crusader
runners.spotlight: Great effort in the The Gold Rush Ascot two back. Stationed mid and sustained a strong run this course for his new stable. Has an excellent second-up record & Pikey comes for the ride. Hard to beat.

runners.name: Desert Lightning
runners.spotlight: Let-up (63-days). Finished well held in heavy ground at Eagle Farm over today's trip. Has won multiple times in wet. Can make his presence felt fresh in this line-up.

runners.name: Evaporate
runners.spotlight: Resuming (19-weeks). Placed in elite company last prep and has had a 2nd & 1st at recent jump-outs. Barrier hurts but possesses early toe. Can definitely play a role.
runners.owner: Mystery Downs, Mrs C M Cook Et Al

runners.name: Attrition
runners.spotlight: First-up (27-weeks). Long time since last saluted. Trial & jump-out were pleasing. Rough exotics hope.
runners.owner: Halo Racing Services Pty Ltd, Ms D M Suss Et Al

runners.name: Wootton Verni
runners.spotlight: First-up (18-weeks). Better suited to longer assignments these days. Others more persuasive.
runners.owner: C J Waller, Go Bloodstock Australia Et Al

runners.name: Coeur Volante
runners.spotlight: Caulfield winner two back. Not far off them at Flemington in a leader dominataed race. Each way claims.
runners.owner: Widden Stud Pty Ltd & Bangaloe Stud

runners.name: Ohope Wins
runners.spotlight: Fronting up for second campaign (18-weeks). Ex New Zealander. Steps out for third Aust start. Australian Oaks winner at Randwick last start back in April. Big watch.

runners.name: Feroce
runners.spotlight: First-up (20-weeks). Has run well fresh. Soft tick, heavy query. Not out of this fresh in this company.
runners.owner: Sutton Racing Pty Ltd, S Chappell Et Al

runners.name: Regal Zeus
runners.spotlight: Let-up (42-days). Finished a long way from the action Glasshouse Hcp at Sunshine Coast. Adverse barrier tests. Leaning towards others here.
runners.owner: Regal Bloodstock, R Livori Et Al

runners.name: Kings Valley
runners.spotlight: First-up (17-weeks). Sound win at Mornington last time. Meets a stronger bunch here .
runners.owner: N A Greenhalgh, Mrs M T Greenhalgh et al

runners.name: Pinstriped
runners.spotlight: Kept fresh following return when got home super behind Coeur Volante here. Can run a race at odds.
runners.owner: E Jusufovic, P J Fulton Et Al

races.race_name: JRA Prix Alec Head (Prix de Pomone) (Group 2) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)

runners.name: Indalimos
runners.spotlight: Best effort came when beating subsequent Group 1 winner Consent and Rabbit's Foot (has improved since) in Group 3 on this weekend a year ago; mainly creditable efforts since, though held by Rabbit's Foot on Chantilly form over this trip on fast ground in June.
runners.comment: Mainly creditable efforts this season but held by Rabbit's Foot on June Chantilly form

runners.name: Rabbit's Foot
runners.spotlight: Group 1-placed last year and ran to best when beating last weekend's German Group 1 winner Tiffany over 1m4f on fast ground at Chantilly in June (below-par Indalimos back in seventh); the one to beat on that evidence.
runners.comment: Ran up to best when beating subsequent German Group 1 winner Tiffany last time; big chance

runners.name: Euboa
runners.spotlight: Claims on pick of efforts, which includes a third placing behind Aventure in Longchamp Group 2 over 1m2f110yds in May; respectable effort at Vichy last time and a player back up in trip.
runners.comment: Decent chance at the weights and running respectably; should go well back up in trip

runners.name: Zakharova
runners.spotlight: Has won three of 12 starts, including a Listed success, and is in good form (just in front of Indalimos at Chantilly last time but now 3lb worse off); return to this trip should suit but more needed to win on these terms back in Group company.
runners.comment: Comes here in good form but she'll have to raise her game to win on these terms

runners.name: Karla Jet
runners.spotlight: Has won half her eight starts and turned in best effort to win Listed event at Clairefontaine on ground described as soft this month; handles a sound surface and should give a good account.
runners.comment: Listed winner at Clairefontaine this month; should give another good account

races.race_name: Prix Guillaume d'Ornano (Group 2) (Turf)

runners.name: Montreal
runners.spotlight: Won a Leopardstown maiden last August by 8l (1m, good), and improved this campaign with a tongue-tie on; his third in the Group 1 Prix du Jockey Club (1m2f110yds, good), when Daryzan was seventh, is the best form in this race and should have plenty more to offer on just his fifth start; likes to go from the front and is entered in Group 1s, including the St Leger.
runners.comment: Third in the Group 1 Prix du Jockey Club gives him the best form claims

runners.name: Daryzan
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to Daryz; impressive on debut at Saint-Cloud (1m, soft) in May and was then only 3l behind Constitution River when upped to Group 1 company straightaway for the Prix du Jockey Club (1m2f110yds, good); didn't need to be anywhere near that level when winning last time and remains with a ton of potential; holds Group 1 entries.
runners.comment: Half-brother to Daryz; lightly raced and has lots of ability; leading claims

runners.name: Proof
runners.spotlight: Showed good form as a 2yo, notably when third in the Group 1 Criterium de Saint-Cloud (1m2f, very soft) in October, but wasn't seen again until a month ago when making all for a Listed-race success at Compiegne (1m2f, good to soft); needs another step forward but is an interesting colt.
runners.comment: Absent for 263 days before recent Listed win; needs a step forward but an interesting colt

runners.name: Baroud
runners.spotlight: Mostly progressive colt and won a 1m4f maiden at Saint-Cloud in April (good to soft) on fourth start before improving on the figures in Pattern company, the most recent the Group 2 Prix Eugene Adam (1m2f, good); needs a bit extra but does come into this on the up.
runners.comment: Won his maiden on fourth start but improved since; needs more, though

runners.name: Hello Jo
runners.spotlight: Started the year in great form on the AW, and his defeat of Segall on that surface in March got a recent boost, but something to prove following his eighth in the Group 2 Derby Italiano (1m3f, heavy) in early June; quicker ground could help others easier to make cases for.
runners.comment: Good form on the AW at start of year, but well beaten last time, albeit on heavy

races.race_name: Darley Prix de Lieurey (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)

runners.name: Hassaleh
runners.spotlight: Stepped up a fair way on her previous efforts when winning Listed 7f event at this track last month; shaped as though she'd have no problems with 1m (backed up by pedigree) and booking of Christophe Lemaire takes the eye; there's likely more to come and she's a player up in grade.
runners.comment: Turned in best effort to win Listed event over 7f here last month; should stay 1m; claims

runners.name: The Prettiest Star
runners.spotlight: Disappointed in the Jersey at Royal Ascot (first run for Wathnan) but has strong claims on the form of her fourth place in the 1,000 Guineas; she's only had four runs and is likely capable of better and no surprise to see her bounce back.
runners.comment: Disappointed in the Jersey but strong claims on form of her 1,000 Guineas fourth place

runners.name: Fortuna Diamond
runners.spotlight: Created a good impression when winning first three starts - including in Listed event over this trip at Longchamp - but had to settle for second on first run in Group company in Germany last time; bit to find at the weights but she's almost certainly capable of better.
runners.comment: Won first three in France but beaten in Group company in Germany last time; can do better

runners.name: Vaticana
runners.spotlight: Heavy ground Listed winner at Saint-Cloud in March and even better effort on good ground in Chantilly Group 2 in May; below that level on AW but interesting to see how she gets on back on turf on first run for trainer.
runners.comment: Decent claims on pick of form and may raise her game on first run for a new trainer

runners.name: Esna
runners.spotlight: Overall form has an uneven look to it but she's a smart sort on her day, as she showed when fourth in last season's Marcel Boussac and when second in Ascot Group 3 last month; Christophe Soumillon rides for the first time and claims, especially if the cheekpieces have a positive effect.
runners.comment: Overall form is uneven but cheekpieces on and good chance on the pick of her efforts

runners.name: Orion's Belt
runners.spotlight: Very useful juvenile whose best effort came in last season's Dick Poole on soft ground at Salisbury; below that level both runs since and plenty on at the weights; this could also come too soon after belated reappearance at Goodwood.
runners.comment: Best form has been on soft and below best on reappearance; plenty to find

runners.name: Awaken
runners.spotlight: Placed in the Albany and in the Rockfell last year but has taken a while to come to hand this season; the signs were much more encouraging at Goodwood last time (met trouble) and she's worth a second look back up in trip (bred to stay 1m) with Ryan Moore taking over for the first time.
runners.comment: Group-placed last year but slow to come to hand this season; more encouragement last time

runners.name: Narissa
runners.spotlight: Third to the unbeaten Diamond Necklace in last season's Marcel Boussac but, while she finished further behind that rival in the Pouliches, she showed improved form to win a Listed AW event last time; just about the pick of the weights and she seems sure to run well.
runners.comment: Good chance at the weights and comes here on the back of a pb on AW; player

runners.name: Braida
runners.spotlight: Is on the upgrade and no problems with ground or trip; something to find strictly on official ratings but is with a top yard and she's interesting on this first outing in Group company.
runners.comment: Progressive sort who steps into Group company for the first time but is capable of better
runners.owner: Alain Jathiere & Khalifa Mohammed Al Attiyah

runners.name: Kozlovskha
runners.spotlight: Placed three times in Listed company over 7f but a long way below her best behind Hassaleh last time and, while that wasn't her running, she has something to prove at these weights back up in trip.
runners.comment: Placed three times in Listed company; back to 1m but work to do at these weights

runners.name: Repel
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in the Sandringham but left that behind when winning Listed event in the French provinces last time; fair bit more needed if she's to follow up back in Group company on these terms.
runners.comment: Won Listed event in the French provinces last time but more to do back in Group company

runners.name: Indifferente
runners.spotlight: Steadily progressive sort who finished second to Timeforshowcasing (since beaten a nose in a German Group 1) in the German 1,000 Guineas in May; hasn't been seen since but won't have to step up too much on that form to play a part.
runners.comment: Steadily progressive sort who turned in best effort in the German 1,000 Guineas; claims

runners.name: Viva La Skids
runners.spotlight: Has won half of her six starts but below best since posting a successful reappearance at Cagnes-sur-mer in February; not seen for five months and faces a stiff task on these terms.
runners.comment: Below best since posting a successful reappearance at Cagnes-sur-mer in February

races.race_name: Prix Gontaut-Biron Hong Kong Jockey Club (Group 3) (Turf)

runners.name: Cualificar
runners.spotlight: Only out of the first four once in 12 starts, that being last year's Arc on very soft, and better than ever this season, recording then matching career bests, the most recent 41 days ago in the Grand Prix de Saint-Cloud (1m4f, good to firm), when Leffard was behind; drop in trip should be fine and sure to run his race.
runners.comment: Better than ever this season, recording then matching career bests; sound claims

runners.name: Wimbledon Hawkeye
runners.spotlight: Won the Grade 3 Nashville Derby last August (1m2f110yds, firm) for previous connections and produced his best performance on the figures when runner-up in the Wolferton Stakes to Map Of Stars at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm); ran well against a pace bias in the Group 1 Grosser Dallmayr-Preis on debut for new trainer/owner and looks to have sound claims; Christophe Soumillon on for first time
runners.comment: Last two runs, including in a Group 1 have been good, and should be thereabouts

runners.name: Map Of Stars
runners.spotlight: Won a Group 2 and 3 plus placed in a Group 1 last year but that season finished on a modest note; opening two starts after being gelded were again below his best but came right back to form in first-time cheekpieces when beating Wimbledon Hawkeye in the Listed Wolferton Stakes at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm); trip and ground no issue, so much depends if headgear works again.
runners.comment: Came right back to form in first-time cheekpieces last time; will headgear work again?

runners.name: Leffard
runners.spotlight: Narrowly beaten early last season by Nitoi but went on to land the 1m4f Group 1 Grand Prix de Paris on good to soft; not won since but plenty of decent runs at the highest level until his most recent; case to be made if forgiving that modest effort in the Grand Prix de Saint-Cloud (1m4f, good to firm) 41 days ago, albeit Cualificar was a long way ahead of him that day.
runners.comment: Not at best last time but case can be made if overlooking that effort down in trip

runners.name: Hand Of God
runners.spotlight: Not had lots of racing for his age and comes into this off a career best in the John Smith's Cup (1m2f56yds, good to firm), but this is a stiff task on his first ever try in Group company; plenty more needed to feature.
runners.comment: Ran a career best in the John Smith's Cup but more needed in first Group race

runners.name: Lakota Beau
runners.spotlight: Would have to be considered a fairly major shock if he placed let alone won this considering he's only won a maiden and conditions event.
runners.comment: Only won a maiden and conditions event; very hard to make a case for at this level

runners.name: Matauri Bay
runners.spotlight: Mostly progressed since joining this trainer, and placed in both Listed and Group company at a mile; not at his best last time, though, and needs first attempt at a new trip to bring about plenty of improvement; hard task.
runners.comment: Not at best last time and needs first attempt at new trip to bring plenty of improvement

runners.name: First Look
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in the Qatar Prix du Jockey Club in 2024 and winner of this 12 months ago, when only four lined up; plenty of decent runs since and also gelded, but comes into this off a modest effort in the Group 1 Prix Ganay (1m2f110yds, good) when last seen in April; owners' retained rider is on Map Of Stars.
runners.comment: Has some good form, especially after being gelded, but absent since modest effort in April

runners.name: Nitoi
runners.spotlight: Beat Leffard a short-neck in a 1m2f Listed race at Chantilly last year early and won another contest at that level in October; comes into this having won a Group 3 at Longchamp 69 days ago so should run well, although task is hard considering he has to give 2lb away to all his rivals.
runners.comment: Comes into this in good form but has to give 2lb away to all rivals
